cells.G284: Use laughter/reaction-moment localization to auto-flag shareable highlight clips (bloopers, celebrations) for GSE's social content pipeline without manual review.

cells.C285: Exploring Deep Learning for Event-Based Saliency Prediction with a Transformer-based Model
cells.D285: Introduces SEST, a transformer-based saliency predictor for event-camera data, validated on a new synthetic UCF-Sports-derived benchmark.
cells.E285: A self-supervised pretrained event-based Swin Transformer backbone with a CNN decoder predicts dynamic visual saliency maps from event streams.
cells.F285: Not relevant — event-camera computer vision research; sports appears only as a benchmark source dataset, no product connection.
cells.G285: No strong angle; at best, saliency-map concepts could someday help auto-crop/frame generated highlight video for social content.

cells.C286: Structure-Guided Entity Resolution: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Robust Name Matching in Complex Linguistic Contexts
cells.D286: Fine-tunes an LLM via curriculum learning to match person names across noisy, multilingual records, deployed in production at Dream11 (fantasy sports) for KYC compliance.
cells.E286: Two-phase training first teaches grammatical/semantic name structure, then optimizes for binary entity-matching, achieving 99% accuracy at scale.
cells.F286: Directly relevant — entity resolution across noisy multi-source player/team names is a core data-pipeline reliability problem for GSE's ingestion of scraped and odds-feed data.
cells.G286: Deploy a similar curriculum-fine-tuned entity resolver to unify player/team identities across Pro-Football-Reference scrapes, odds feeds, and internal IDs, reducing pipeline join errors.

cells.C287: Decoupling Spatio-Temporal Adapter for Fine-Grained Badminton Action Localization
cells.D287: Introduces a new fine-grained badminton stroke dataset and a parameter-efficient adapter that decomposes motion into temporal and spatial branches for precise action localization.
cells.E287: A Decoupling Spatio-Temporal Adapter splits motion representation into temporal, vertical, and horizontal spatial branches within a lightweight fine-tuning framework.
cells.F287: Weak thread — fine-grained sports video action recognition, not predictive modeling; only tangential to potential future event-level data enrichment.
cells.G287: Could inspire granular stroke-level event tagging for niche sports (e.g., tennis/badminton) content generation if GSE expands beyond mainstream US sports.

cells.C288: Concepts Worth Having: Refining VLM-Guided Concept Bottleneck Models with Minimal Annotations
cells.D288: Introduces a hybrid concept-bottleneck model combining VLM-derived concepts with minimal human annotation via Gaussian Process propagation, improving concept accuracy and calibration.
cells.E288: A Gaussian Process over a VLM's embedding space propagates a small set of expert-labeled concept annotations to unlabeled data, refining interpretable concept predictions.
cells.F288: Tangential — interpretable concept-bottleneck models with better calibration resonate with GSE's 'math you can read' transparency requirement, even though the domain is unrelated.
cells.G288: Adapt concept-bottleneck architecture so GSE's pick explanations surface human-readable intermediate 'concepts' (e.g., pace, injury risk) rather than an opaque final score.

cells.C289: MyoChallenge 2025: A New Benchmark for Human Athletic Intelligence
cells.D289: Reports results of a NeurIPS competition benchmarking musculoskeletal motor-control algorithms on simulated table tennis and soccer penalty-kick tasks.
cells.E289: High-fidelity biomechanical simulation (MyoSuite) evaluates RL-based control algorithms (motion planners, behavior cloning, hierarchical planning) for sports-like muscle coordination.
cells.F289: Not relevant to GSE's product — biomechanics/robotics competition, no forecasting or calibration angle.
cells.G289: No direct application; at most a curiosity reference if GSE's persistent web game (AUGUR) ever wanted physics-based athlete simulation mechanics.

cells.C290: PDRNN: Modular Data-driven Pedestrian Dead Reckoning on Loosely Coupled Radio- and Inertial-Signalstreams
cells.D290: Proposes a modular RNN-based pedestrian dead-reckoning system fusing radio and inertial sensor streams with uncertainty estimates, tested on dynamic sports movement data.
cells.E290: Independent ML ensembles estimate orientation, velocity, and position components with variance, fused by a final model that uses uncertainty for robustness.
cells.F290: Tangential — the modular ensemble-with-uncertainty-estimation design pattern parallels GSE's need for uncertainty-aware, swappable per-sport sub-models feeding an ensemble.
cells.G290: Borrow the 'independent component models fused with explicit uncertainty' architecture as a template for GSE's per-sport probability ensemble feeding into bootstrap-mode confidence capping.

cells.C291: Exploitation of Hidden Context in Dynamic Movement Forecasting: RNN to GNN and Transformers
cells.D291: Benchmarks ARIMA/Kalman/Particle filters against LSTM, GNN, and Transformer models for forecasting NBA player movement, finding a hybrid contextual LSTM performs best.
cells.E291: Compares classical time-series filters and modern ML architectures on trajectory forecast error (FDE) across input history lengths and contextual conditioning.
cells.F291: Directly relevant — this is exactly GSE's core problem (beating naive/classical baselines with better time-series forecasting) applied to NBA data, showing no single architecture wins universally.
cells.G291: Use the paper's finding that context-augmented LSTM beats pure Transformers/GNNs to guide GSE's model-architecture choice when trying to beat its 5.31 vs 4.91 MAE naive-baseline deficit.

cells.C292: Heteroscedastic Diffusion for Multi-Agent Trajectory Modeling
cells.D292: Introduces a diffusion model (U2Diffine) providing trajectory completion with state-wise heteroscedastic uncertainty and per-mode error-probability ranking across four sports datasets.
cells.E292: Augments diffusion denoising loss with predicted-noise negative log-likelihood, propagates latent uncertainty to real state space, and ranks generated modes via a RankNN.
cells.F292: Directly relevant — uncertainty-aware generative forecasting with per-scenario error probabilities is a strong technical analog to GSE's need for calibrated, uncertainty-quantified predictions.
cells.G292: Adapt the RankNN-style error-probability ranking to score which of GSE's ensemble scenario forecasts to trust most, feeding directly into the bootstrap-mode confidence cap.

cells.C293: Cross-Individual Generalizability of ML Models for Ball Speed Prediction in Baseball Pitching
cells.D293: Shows ML models predicting pitch ball speed generalize poorly across individuals (R² drops from 0.91 to 0.38 out-of-subject), with systematic bias by skill level.
cells.E293: Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation isolates biomechanical features (trunk, pivot leg) that generalize best across pitchers of different expertise.
cells.F293: Tangential — a cautionary empirical finding about generalization failure that supports GSE's hypothesis that a single global calibrator underperforms sport/context-specific models.
cells.G293: Use the paper's evidence for individual-level heterogeneity as justification data-point when pitching the case internally for per-sport (or even per-player-tier) probability models over one global calibrator.

cells.C294: From Beats to Breaches: How Offensive AI Infers Sensitive User Information from Playlists
cells.D294: Develops musicPIIrate, a deep-learning attack inferring demographics and traits (including sport habits) from public music playlists, plus a defensive dummy-injection countermeasure.
cells.E294: Deep Sets and graph neural networks model playlist structure to predict PII attributes; JamShield injects decoy playlists to dilute the inference signal.
cells.F294: Not relevant to GSE's core product — a privacy-attack/defense paper in music streaming; the weakest possible thread is general awareness of PII-inference risk from user behavioral data.
cells.G294: Apply the JamShield-style defensive noise-injection concept if GSE ever needs to obfuscate user betting/pick history from third-party inference attacks.

cells.C295: Selective Correlation Based Knowledge Distillation for Ground Reaction Force Estimation
cells.D295: Proposes a knowledge-distillation method using selected temporal correlation features to estimate ground reaction force from cheap wearable insole sensors instead of costly force plates.
cells.E295: Selective Correlation Knowledge Distillation transfers correlation-map information from a teacher to a compact student model for real-time, resource-efficient GRF estimation.
cells.F295: Not relevant — wearable biomechanics sensor research; only a generic 'knowledge distillation for efficient models' technique thread.
cells.G295: The distillation-for-efficiency pattern could be reused to compress GSE's ensemble models for low-latency in-app scoring without losing calibration accuracy.

cells.C296: KellyBench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Sequential Decision Making
cells.D296: Introduces a benchmark placing LLM agents in a simulated EPL betting season, finding all frontier models lose money on average and show unsophisticated strategy versus human experts.
cells.E296: Agents get historical stats/odds/lineups and must build models, find market edge, and manage bankroll growth (Kelly-style) over a season-long simulation, graded by a human rubric.
cells.F296: Extremely relevant — this is essentially a stress-test of GSE's exact use case (sports betting edge-finding, bankroll management, market efficiency) using LLM agents as the decision-maker.
cells.G296: Run GSE's own prediction-engine outputs through the KellyBench harness as an external, adversarial validation of whether its edge and bankroll strategy actually beats a naive baseline over a season.

cells.C297: Deep Interest Mining for Intent-Enriched Semantic IDs in Multimodal Generative Recommendation
cells.D297: Proposes DeepInterestGR, enriching generative recommendation item IDs with VLM captions and LLM-mined intent descriptors, tested partly on Amazon Sports product data.
cells.E297: Pre-quantization item evidence enrichment (visual + intent) combined with relevance-gated semantic rewards improves generative recommender NDCG.
cells.F297: Not relevant — e-commerce product recommendation; 'Sports' is just an Amazon product category, no connection to GSE's prediction/calibration work.
cells.G297: No strong application beyond generic recommender-system technique reuse if GSE ever builds a personalized pick/content recommendation feed.

cells.C298: Forecast Sports Outcomes under Efficient Market Hypothesis: Theoretical and Experimental Analysis of Odds-Only and Generalised Linear Models
cells.D298: Proposes improved methods (OO-EPC odds-only conversion and FL-GLM) for converting betting odds to outcome probabilities, outperforming existing Multiplicative/Shin/Power methods on 90K football matches.
cells.E298: OO-EPC aligns bookmaker pricing with equal-profitability confidence per outcome; FL-GLM fits a single interpretable parameter capturing favourite-longshot bias beyond market efficiency.
cells.F298: Extremely relevant — directly addresses converting odds to probabilities for market-efficiency benchmarking (closing-line value), core to GSE's public accuracy standards and calibration work.
cells.G298: Replace or augment GSE's current odds-to-probability conversion with OO-EPC/FL-GLM to get a more accurate, bias-corrected baseline for measuring closing-line value against.

cells.C299: BasketHAR: A Multimodal Dataset for Human Activity Recognition and Sport Analysis in Basketball Training Scenarios
cells.D299: Presents a multimodal wearable+video dataset of professional-level basketball training actions with a baseline multimodal alignment benchmark.
cells.E299: Synchronized IMU, heart rate, skin temperature, and video data support supervised human activity recognition specific to basketball training movements.
cells.F299: Weak thread — a training/wearables dataset, not predictive game analytics; tangential at best to GSE's core product.
cells.G299: Could inform a future 'player readiness/fatigue' signal if GSE ever incorporates wearable-derived training-load data into injury-risk features.

cells.C300: MambaKick: Early Penalty Direction Prediction from HAR Embeddings
cells.D300: Uses pretrained human-action-recognition embeddings and a Mamba state-space model to predict soccer penalty-kick direction early from short video clips.
cells.E300: Reuses transferable spatiotemporal HAR embeddings and aggregates them with a selective state-space model for low-latency intention prediction.
cells.F300: Weak thread — a niche computer-vision prediction task (penalty direction), not aligned with GSE's game-outcome forecasting focus.
cells.G300: Could inspire a novel in-play prop-bet feature (e.g., penalty outcome prediction) if GSE expands into micro-market/live betting products.

cells.C301: A Methodology to Rank Importance of Frequencies and Channels in Electromyography Data with Decision Tree Classifiers
cells.D301: Uses decision trees to identify the most informative EMG frequency bands and muscle channels for assessing recovery after squat exercise.
cells.E301: Grid-search-tuned Decision Tree classifiers rank power-spectral-density features for interpretable classification of rest-interval adequacy.
cells.F301: Not relevant — EMG-based muscle recovery diagnostics; only a faint thread via interpretable feature-importance methodology relevant to GSE's transparency ethos.
cells.G301: No direct application; the interpretable-feature-ranking approach could be borrowed generically to explain which input features drive a given pick's score.

cells.C302: Simulation-Based Optimisation of Batting Order and Bowling Plans in T20 Cricket
cells.D302: Builds an MDP framework optimizing T20 cricket batting order and bowling plans directly in win/defend probability terms using James-Stein shrinkage and Monte Carlo simulation on IPL data.
cells.E302: A three-phase player-profile engine with James-Stein shrinkage feeds a 50,000-trajectory Monte Carlo simulation to search over batting orders and bowling assignments for maximum win probability.
cells.F302: Highly relevant — James-Stein shrinkage for sparse phase-specific player data is a direct statistical analog to GSE's 'bootstrap mode' sparse-data confidence adjustment, plus win-probability Monte Carlo modeling for cricket.
cells.G302: Adopt James-Stein shrinkage explicitly as the mechanism behind bootstrap mode, blending sparse-sample team/player estimates toward league averages in a principled, published way GSE can cite publicly.

cells.C303: Driving Engagement in Daily Fantasy Sports with a Scalable and Urgency-Aware Ranking Engine
cells.D303: Describes a production deep-learning recommendation engine that ranks daily fantasy sports matches by urgency (time-to-lock) at industrial scale, improving nDCG by 9%.
cells.E303: A Deep Interest Network injects real-time urgency features and temporal positional encodings, trained with neuralNDCG loss on a multi-GPU Ray/PyTorch pipeline over 100B+ interactions.
cells.F303: Relevant — an industrial-scale, deadline-aware ranking system maps directly onto GSE's pick lifecycle (proposed→modeled→published/locked) and its need to surface time-sensitive picks before lock.
cells.G303: Repurpose the urgency-aware ranking architecture to power a 'picks closing soon' feed that reorders GSE's published picks in real time as lock deadlines approach.

cells.C304: GenTac: Generative Modeling and Forecasting of Soccer Tactics
cells.D304: Introduces a diffusion-based generative framework (GenTac) modeling soccer tactics as a stochastic process over player trajectories and events, generalizing to basketball, football, and hockey.
cells.E304: Learns the distribution of multi-player trajectories conditioned on team/league style and strategic objectives, sampling diverse plausible long-horizon rollouts grounded in a discrete tactical event space.
cells.F304: Relevant — a generative, uncertainty-preserving multi-agent forecasting approach that generalizes across GSE's core sports (NFL, basketball, hockey), directly applicable to improving its underperforming forecasting model.
cells.G304: Use GenTac-style counterfactual rollouts (altering offensive/defensive guidance) to generate scenario-based confidence intervals around GSE's picks rather than a single point forecast.

cells.C305: ExpertEdit: Learning Skill-Aware Motion Editing from Expert Videos
cells.D305: Trains an unpaired motion-editing model that projects novice athlete motion onto an expert manifold to generate personalized skill-improvement feedback across three sports.
cells.E305: A masked-language-modeling-style motion prior infills skill-critical motion spans with expert-level refinements, requiring no paired data or manual edit guidance.
cells.F305: Weak thread — a sports-coaching motion-editing tool, unrelated to GSE's forecasting/calibration product.
cells.G305: Could loosely inspire an AR-style 'compare your play to elite form' feature for the Galaxy Dynasty/AUGUR game layer, unrelated to core prediction.

cells.C306: Schema on the Inside: A Two-Phase Fine-Tuning Method for High-Efficiency Text-to-SQL at Scale
cells.D306: Presents a self-hosted 8B-parameter text-to-SQL model that internalizes database schema via two-phase fine-tuning for a cricket-stats chatbot in Dream11's CriQ app, cutting tokens 99%.
cells.E306: Two-phase supervised fine-tuning bakes the schema into model weights, eliminating long-context prompts and replacing costly API calls with efficient local inference.
cells.F306: Relevant — a production fantasy-sports natural-language stats query system is directly applicable to GSE's own agentic tooling and potential 'ask the data' interface over its prediction/odds database.
cells.G306: Fine-tune a small self-hosted model on GSE's Prisma/PostgreSQL schema to power a low-latency natural-language stats assistant for internal analysts or B2B widget users.

cells.C307: OpenGuanDan: A Large-Scale Imperfect Information Game Benchmark
cells.D307: Introduces a large-scale benchmark for the four-player Chinese card game GuanDan, evaluating learning-based and rule-based AI agents under imperfect information and mixed cooperation/competition.
cells.E307: Simulates the game with a per-player API, enabling human-AI matchups and pairwise agent competitions to benchmark decision-making under imperfect information and dynamic teams.
cells.F307: Weak thread — multi-agent decision-making under imperfect information is conceptually close to GSE's own internal agent work but the domain (card game) has no direct sports-prediction application.
cells.G307: Use OpenGuanDan's evaluation methodology (pairwise agent competition, human-AI matchups) as a template for benchmarking GSE's own multi-agent research tools (Jarvis/Hermes/Fable) against each other.

cells.C308: Dismantling Hate: Understanding Hate Speech Trends Against NBA Athletes
cells.D308: Uses a deep-learning classifier on Twitter data to identify NBA athletes targeted by hate speech and characterize themes (racism, physique shaming, anti-LGBTQ remarks).
cells.E308: Keyword-based tweet collection combined with a hate-speech classification model identifies targeted athlete groups and dominant hate-speech topics.
cells.F308: Tangential — relevant to GSE's automated social/media content generation and brand-safety needs if it engages with fan commentary or generates athlete-related content that could attract abuse.
cells.G308: Build a hate-speech/toxicity filter into GSE's automated social content pipeline to avoid amplifying or engaging with abusive athlete-directed commentary near published picks.

cells.C309: Identifying Crisis Response Communities in Online Social Networks for Compound Disasters: The Case of Hurricane Laura and Covid-19
cells.D309: Analyzes Twitter communication networks during Hurricane Laura and COVID-19 using community detection and NLP to characterize crisis-response communities, noting sports pages among engaged accounts.
cells.E309: Network science community-detection algorithms combined with topic modeling (word clouds, bigrams) segment Twitter users into risk-taking/risk-averse crisis-response communities.
cells.F309: Not relevant — disaster crisis-communication research; only a passing mention of sports pages as engaged social accounts, no substantive connection to GSE.
cells.G309: No meaningful application beyond generic social-network community-detection techniques potentially reusable for identifying influential sports-fan communities for content targeting.

cells.C310: SC2EGSet: StarCraft II Esport Replay and Game-state Dataset
cells.D310: Releases the largest public dataset of StarCraft II esports tournament replays with tooling for extraction and machine-learning modeling.
cells.E310: A low-level API parser extracts raw and preprocessed replay data from 55 tournament replaypacks, with PyTorch/Lightning loaders for downstream modeling.
cells.F310: Weak thread — esports data curation and open-sourced ETL tooling is tangentially relevant as a model for GSE's own multi-source sports data pipeline engineering.
cells.G310: Mirror this dataset's open-tooling approach to publish a sanitized, versioned historical dataset of GSE's own settled picks and features, supporting reproducible internal backtesting.

cells.C311: floodlight — A High-Level, Data-Driven Sports Analytics Framework
cells.D311: Introduces an open-source, provider- and sport-independent Python package automating team-sport spatiotemporal tracking and event data analysis.
cells.E311: Provides data classes, file parsers, preprocessing routines, standard analysis algorithms, and visualization tools spanning multiple sports and data providers.
cells.F311: Directly relevant — a sport-agnostic, standardized data-ingestion and preprocessing framework maps closely onto GSE's multi-sport (NFL/MLB/MLS) data-pipeline needs.
cells.G311: Evaluate floodlight (or its architectural patterns) as a foundation/reference implementation for standardizing GSE's own multi-source, multi-sport ingestion layer instead of building bespoke per-sport parsers.

cells.C312: A Deep Multi-View Learning Framework for City Event Extraction from Twitter Data Streams
cells.D312: Proposes a hierarchical multi-view deep-learning model extracting city events (traffic, cultural, sports) from Twitter text streams, validated against official transit and event records.
cells.E312: Multi-view representation learning contextualizes tweets into event categories, achieving 81% accuracy versus authoritative event-report ground truth.
cells.F312: Weak thread — general social-media event-extraction NLP; only nominally touches sports as one event category, no direct GSE application.
cells.G312: Adapt the multi-view Twitter event-extraction approach to auto-detect breaking sports news (injuries, lineup changes) from social streams to feed GSE's data pipeline faster than official sources.

cells.C313: iWinRNFL: A Simple, Interpretable & Well-Calibrated In-Game Win Probability Model for NFL
cells.D313: Builds an open, interpretable logistic-regression in-game NFL win-probability model using 10 play-by-play variables, achieving 75% accuracy and strong calibration versus proprietary black-box models.
cells.E313: Logistic regression trained on 7 seasons of play-by-play data produces well-calibrated running win probabilities, with non-linear models tested but showing no significant gain.
cells.F313: Extremely relevant — a directly analogous open, interpretable, well-calibrated win-probability model that embodies exactly the 'math you can read' philosophy and calibration rigor GSE needs to pass its launch gate.
cells.G313: Use iWinRNFL's simple logistic-regression baseline as a public, citable benchmark GSE can beat (or match) to credibly demonstrate its calibration claims once its own model clears the Brier/ECE gate.

cells.C314: AI Soccer Analyst: Stage-Aware and Verifiable Human-AI Collaboration for Soccer Data Analysis
cells.D314: Presents a mixed-initiative system with revisable analysis stages (planning, execution, evidence-grounded reporting) for soccer data analysis, evaluated for verifiability and human control.
cells.E314: A stage-aware LLM pipeline (Data Understanding, Problem Definition, Structured Planning, Execution, Reporting, Refinement) keeps each decision inspectable and revisable by domain analysts.
cells.F314: Highly relevant — a verifiable, stage-aware human-AI collaboration architecture for sports analytics is directly applicable to GSE's internal Jarvis/Hermes/Fable agents and its trust/compliance toolkit.
cells.G314: Adopt the stage-aware, evidence-grounded reporting pattern as the operating model for GSE's autonomous research agents so every model change or calibration fix is auditable and analyst-revisable before deployment.

cells.C315: Ranking by Points and Ordinal Models
cells.D315: Establishes when a sports league's fixed point-per-outcome scoring is a statistically sufficient summary, showing it requires a constant-sum, adjacent-categories probabilistic structure.
cells.E315: Proves sufficiency conditions linking point-scoring rules to an ordinal probability model, and compares Elo-based versus points-based team rankings across nine real leagues.
cells.F315: Directly relevant — rigorous statistical theory connecting simple scoring/ranking rules to proper probabilistic models, aligned with GSE's 'math you can read' rigor and per-sport ranking/model design.
cells.G315: Use the sufficiency framework to formally justify (or redesign) GSE's sport-specific rating/ranking components so they're provably consistent with the underlying probability model, strengthening public methodology claims.

cells.C316: CAS-FD: Contact-Aware Temporal Sampling for Single-View Foul vs Dive Recognition
cells.D316: Introduces a balanced dataset and contact-aware sampling method that improves single-camera recognition of genuine fouls versus simulated dives in football by 12 points accuracy.
cells.E316: Concentrates model attention around the moment of physical contact rather than sampling all frames equally, boosting fine-grained event classification.
cells.F316: Weak thread — a niche computer-vision officiating task; tangential to GSE only as a potential future automated event-tagging feature for content generation.
cells.G316: Could power an automated 'controversial call' highlight detector for GSE's social content generation, flagging foul/dive moments worth commentary.

cells.C317: Longitudinal Bayesian Networks for Assessing Team Performance in the National Basketball Association
cells.D317: Proposes a Bayesian network framework treating basketball performance variables as longitudinal stochastic processes, comparing static, autoregressive, and hidden-Markov dynamic Bayesian networks on real NBA data.
cells.E317: Static and dynamic Bayesian networks (autoregressive and hidden-Markov structured) jointly model player participation, minutes, fouls, and shot attempts over a season.
cells.F317: Highly relevant — a Bayesian graphical modeling framework for longitudinal team performance is directly applicable to GSE's stated need for better ensemble/Bayesian methods and per-sport probability models to fix its calibration failure.
cells.G317: Adopt a dynamic Bayesian network as one member of GSE's ensemble to explicitly model latent team-state evolution game-to-game, potentially improving both calibration and the losing MAE backtest.

cells.C318: NBAStreaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams
cells.D318: Introduces a 307-hour, 35K-event benchmark and causal two-stage framework for generating factually grounded live basketball commentary from continuous broadcast streams.
cells.E318: Completion-first event localization combined with ball-centric semantic grounding organizes scene/event/identity/action cues to generate real-time natural-language commentary online.
cells.F318: Directly relevant — real-time, factually grounded commentary generation from live game streams is squarely within GSE's automated social/media content generation ambitions.
cells.G318: License or replicate this causal commentary-generation approach to auto-produce live, fact-checked play-by-play social posts tied to GSE's in-flight picks as games unfold.

cells.C319: Democratizing Ski Safety: Real-Time Turn Segmentation with Smartphone IMU and Causal LSTM Networks
cells.D319: Builds a causal LSTM model using only smartphone IMU sensors to segment ski turns in real time for injury-prevention feedback, achieving 89.8% directional accuracy on-device.
cells.E319: A causal (past-only) LSTM trained with Leave-One-Subject-Out validation performs real-time turn classification from inertial sensor streams for low-latency mobile deployment.
cells.F319: Not relevant — consumer ski-safety wearable app; only a faint thread via the causal, low-latency on-device inference technique.
cells.G319: No direct application; the causal on-device LSTM pattern could generically inform low-latency edge inference if GSE ever needed mobile-side real-time scoring.

cells.C320: From Sports to Safety: Benchmarking Proactive Risk Inference in MLLMs
cells.D320: Introduces SPRINT, a benchmark of ~2,900 sports videos testing whether multimodal LLMs can proactively predict physical hazards/accidents before they happen, finding models over-trigger false alarms.
cells.E320: Fine-grained annotations of early hazard cues, accident timing, and causes across 14 sports evaluate MLLM hazard-sensitivity versus cause-grounded understanding under various prompts.
cells.F320: Not relevant — sports video used purely as a proxy domain for general physical-safety AI benchmarking, unrelated to GSE's outcome-prediction product.
cells.G320: No meaningful product application; at most, the finding that MLLMs over-trigger false alarms is a general caution about deploying any generative-AI safety/anomaly layer without careful calibration.

cells.C321: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
cells.D321: Reports results of a challenge testing whether multimodal LLMs trained on daily-life egocentric video generalize to novel domains including surgery, industrial assembly, and extreme sports.
cells.E321: Two competition tracks (source-limited and open-source) evaluate cross-domain generalization of egocentric video QA models via multiple-choice benchmarks.
cells.F321: Not relevant — a general cross-domain multimodal generalization benchmark; extreme sports is just one of four evaluated domains, no connection to GSE's business.
cells.G321: No meaningful application to GSE's product beyond the generic lesson that cross-domain generalization in multimodal models remains difficult, relevant only abstractly to their own model transfer concerns.

cells.C322: Sen-Cap: Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient Human Motion Capture via LiDAR-Camera Integration
cells.D322: Proposes a calibration-free motion-capture framework fusing LiDAR and camera data robust to sensor noise and failures, mentioning sports analytics as a use case.
cells.E322: A Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator reconstructs pose without explicit calibration, paired with a noise-resistant trajectory tracker for real-time operation.
cells.F322: Not relevant — hardware-based motion-capture research; sports analytics is only listed as one nominal downstream application.

cells.C323: Auditing Semantic Gains in Sequential Recommendation: A Lightweight Recovery Test
cells.D323: Introduces LIME-Rec, an auditable multi-expert fusion test (sequential, co-occurrence, semantic) that attributes performance gains in recommenders, tested partly on Amazon Sports data.
cells.E323: Three independent experts are combined via auditable score-level fusion and bounded history calibration, isolating whether gains come from genuine semantic signal versus representation capacity.
cells.F323: Tangential — the auditable multi-expert fusion-plus-calibration methodology parallels GSE's ensemble/calibration work, though the domain is e-commerce recommendation, not sports outcome prediction.
cells.G323: Apply LIME-Rec's attribution methodology to audit whether GSE's planned ensemble redesign genuinely improves calibration versus just adding opaque model complexity.

cells.C324: AIx4Soccer: A Unified Platform Architecture for Football Club Management and Structured Athlete Development
cells.D324: Presents a conceptual multi-tenant SaaS platform unifying football club-management workflows around an event-centric, append-only knowledge-graph data model and athlete-development framework.
cells.E324: Specifies a typed, immutable event log architecture inducing a growing knowledge graph, plus a two-sided video-analyst marketplace and structured development-plan methodology.
cells.F324: Highly relevant — its event-centric, typed, append-only knowledge-graph data model is a close conceptual blueprint for GSE's planned 'Intelligence Graph' layer.
cells.G324: Adopt the append-only typed-event-log architecture as the technical foundation for GSE's Intelligence Graph, ensuring every pick, odds update, and grading event is an immutable, queryable fact.

cells.C325: BasketEvent: Understanding Who Did What and When in Basketball Videos
cells.D325: Introduces a player-centric NBA broadcast dataset and PlayNet model that grounds basketball events to specific players with precise temporal boundaries.
cells.E325: Tracks entities, associates player identities, and models player-player/player-ball/court interactions with gated pooling to localize event evidence temporally.
cells.F325: Relevant (adjacent) — extracting player-attributed, temporally grounded events from broadcast video is a potential future data-enrichment source for GSE's Intelligence Graph beyond box-score data.
cells.G325: Use player-centric event extraction to auto-generate granular 'who did what when' facts feeding both the Intelligence Graph and automated highlight-commentary content.

cells.C326: Improving Punching 'Power': Reconsidering the Roles of Initial Strike Velocity and Effective Mass
cells.D326: A physics analysis of combat-sports strikes showing effective mass, not just strike velocity, independently and often dominantly determines impact force on a target.
cells.E326: One-dimensional elastic-collision modeling with numerical analysis quantifies how bounded pre-collision velocity limits impulse compared to variable effective mass.
cells.F326: Not relevant — physics of martial-arts biomechanics, no connection to GSE's sports-outcome prediction business.

cells.C327: FST.ai 2.5: Explainable and Uncertainty-Aware AI for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo Decision Support
cells.D327: Presents a unified, explainable, uncertainty-aware AI ecosystem for taekwondo federations covering athlete digital twins, referee decision support, and federation-scale analytics.
cells.E327: Integrates multi-source competition and athlete data with explainable performance indicators and uncertainty-aware forecasting under transparent, secure federation governance.

cells.C328: Authoring Narrative Visualization in Motion: Visual Storytelling in Swimming Videos
cells.D328: Develops an automated pipeline and authoring tool that extracts structured data from swimming race videos and embeds narrative data visualizations directly into the broadcast footage.
cells.E328: An automated data-extraction pipeline combined with derived narrative constructs powers a technology probe letting content creators author moving data visualizations in sports video.

cells.D329: Reports results of the sixth annual SoccerNet computer-vision benchmark covering ball action anticipation, player-centric action spotting, novel view synthesis, player localization, and video QA.
cells.E329: Provides annotated data, unified evaluation protocols, and public baselines across five vision tasks, summarizing leaderboard results from 427 participating teams.

cells.C330: A Behavioral Principle Underlying Attacker-Defender Interactions in Soccer
cells.D330: Develops a mathematical model of one-on-one soccer attacker-defender dynamics from 306 professional games, finding defenders minimize future relative speed while attackers preempt this goal.
cells.E330: A relative-speed-minimization behavioral principle, validated against large-scale tracking data, offers a unified account of pursuit-evasion dynamics generalizable to other invasion sports.
cells.F330: Relevant — a rigorous, interpretable mathematical model of in-game micro-dynamics is exactly the kind of 'math you can read' feature-engineering input GSE could use for per-sport probability models.
cells.G330: Encode the relative-speed-minimization principle as a derived tactical feature (defensive pressure quality) feeding GSE's soccer/MLS win-probability models, adding interpretable signal beyond box scores.

cells.C331: DisciplineGen-1M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multidisciplinary Visual Generation and Editing
cells.D331: Introduces a 1.2M-sample dataset and reasoning-informed model for generating and editing knowledge-intensive diagrams across ten disciplines including sports, aiming for verifiable, structured image generation.
cells.E331: Structured rendering, OCR-based editing, and programmatic synthesis pipelines produce captioned, controllable image-editing pairs for training discipline-aware generation models.

cells.C332: Digitizing Coaching Intelligence: An Agentic Framework for Holistic Athlete Profiling using VLM and RAG
cells.D332: Presents a LangGraph-orchestrated multi-agent framework combining computer vision and vision-language models with a self-correcting RAG pipeline for automated, standards-compliant athlete profiling.
cells.E332: Combines MediaPipe kinematic tracking with VLM semantic reasoning via 'Smart Grid' chunking, an LLM-as-judge self-correction loop, and a ChromaDB RAG layer for natural-language athlete queries.

cells.C333: From Streaks to Synergies: A Multi-Scale Analysis of Performance and Scoring in the NBA
cells.D333: Uses statistics, network science, and complexity science on 7,558 NBA games (2020-2025) to quantify scoring patterns, player synergies, and streak dynamics at multiple scales.
cells.E333: Combines classical statistical methods with network-science techniques on play-by-play data to derive evidence-based insights into in-game and in-season performance.
cells.F333: Directly relevant — large-scale NBA play-by-play statistical/network analysis directly informs feature engineering for GSE's basketball probability models and its per-sport calibration work.

cells.C334: 1000 Rallies: An Event-Camera Dataset and Real-Time Learned Ball-State Estimation for Robotic Table Tennis
cells.D334: Releases a large event-camera table-tennis dataset and trains a CNN plus Kalman filter to estimate ball position/velocity in real time, enabling human-robot rallies.
cells.E334: An event-based CNN predicts ball position/velocity from microsecond-resolution event streams, fused via Kalman filtering to reduce bounce-point prediction error by 36%.
cells.F334: Not relevant — robotic perception hardware research; only a faint thread via the Kalman-filter state-estimation technique.
cells.G334: No meaningful product application beyond generic state-estimation technique reuse.

cells.C335: Ranking Football Teams via the Higher-Order Decomposition of Performance Networks
cells.D335: Combines event-level metrics, higher-order network representations (Hodge decomposition), and algebraic methods to rank football teams, revealing league-specific 'competition style' fingerprints.
cells.E335: Metric-specific weighted performance graphs are decomposed via Hodge decomposition; the gradient component yields ratings, with solenoidal-flow energy quantifying structural ranking limits.
cells.F335: Directly relevant — a novel, mathematically rigorous, league-adaptive team-ranking methodology directly applicable to GSE's per-sport probability model and ranking design work.
cells.G335: Evaluate Hodge-decomposition-based composite ratings as an alternative or complementary signal to GSE's current per-sport model, especially for leagues showing high 'topological inconsistency' where simple ratings fail.

cells.C336: Emotional Driving: Reference-Dependent Emotions and Risky Driving Behavior After Sporting Events
cells.D336: Finds that close, suspenseful NFL losses cause a significant spike in risky post-game driving speeds near stadiums, driven by pre-game suspense combined with negative outcome valence.
cells.E336: Analyzes vehicle-speed and crash data around stadiums via reference-dependent (prospect-theory-style) emotion modeling tied to predicted-close games and outcome valence.
cells.F336: Tangential — the reference-dependent expectation/disappointment framing echoes probabilistic expectation-setting, and the 'game suspense' metric could inform GSE's automated content engagement features.
cells.G336: Build a 'game suspense index' from GSE's own live win-probability swings to auto-flag the most emotionally charged games for prioritized social/media content generation.

cells.C337: What Prediction Markets Can See: Market Formation, Settlement Legibility, and the Geography of Tradable Uncertainty in Africa and Latin America
cells.D337: Studies why certain uncertainties become tradable prediction-market contracts at all, finding sports and elections dominate due to high 'settlement legibility' versus civic/conflict events.
cells.E337: A validated settlement-legibility coding scheme (how easily an outcome can be sourced and resolved) is tested against 6,047 Polymarket/Kalshi contracts to explain market formation and trading value.
cells.F337: Directly relevant — deep analysis of why sports dominate prediction-market inventory (high settlement legibility) underpins GSE's market-efficiency/closing-line-value benchmarking framing.
cells.G337: Use the settlement-legibility framework to formally justify to partners/regulators why sports outcomes are uniquely well-suited to GSE's deterministic scoring approach versus fuzzier prediction domains.

cells.C338: SED: Lightweight Saliency Prediction for Event-based Data via Distillation
cells.D338: Proposes a knowledge-distilled, 562x-smaller lightweight network for event-camera saliency prediction, tested partly on a synthetic UCF-Sports-derived benchmark.
cells.E338: A Depthwise Spatio-Temporal Block factorizes 3D convolutions, trained via knowledge distillation to match a much larger teacher model at a fraction of the size.
cells.F338: Not relevant — edge-device computer-vision saliency research; sports appears only as an incidental benchmark dataset.
cells.G338: No meaningful application beyond the generic model-compression-via-distillation technique.

cells.C339: SOMA: From Surface Observations to Muscle Anatomy
cells.D339: Presents a method to infer internal muscle deformation from external body-surface video, aiming to provide anatomically grounded animations for medicine, sports, and entertainment.
cells.E339: A person-specific inverse model recovers spatio-temporal muscle behavior from multi-view RGB surface signals, paired with a new soft-tissue deformation dataset.
cells.F339: Not relevant — biomechanical/graphics muscle-modeling research; sports is one nominal application area with no connection to GSE's prediction engine.
cells.G339: No meaningful application to GSE's product.

cells.C340: Gravity-guided Contact Dynamics Estimation from 3D Human Motions
cells.D340: Proposes GraCE, a model estimating ground-reaction contact forces directly from motion-capture data using center-of-gravity and mass-distribution physics, useful for sports performance analysis.
cells.E340: Estimates ground contact points via distance to the body's center of gravity and computes applied force from predicted contact probabilities and total exterior force.
cells.F340: Not relevant — biomechanics ground-force estimation research with no thread to GSE's outcome-prediction business.

cells.C341: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
cells.D341: Introduces a massive benchmark (35K hours video, 15M actions) using basketball, soccer, and hockey to test multimodal/agentic models on perception, causal reasoning, strategic simulation, and agentic evidence-gathering.
cells.E341: Nine tasks across a four-pillar hierarchy evaluate models from perceptual QA through autonomous multi-clip evidence synthesis, revealing sharp performance drop-off at higher cognitive levels.
cells.F341: Relevant — a large multi-sport benchmark explicitly testing causal reasoning and agentic strategic synthesis closely parallels what GSE's internal agents (Jarvis/Hermes/Fable) would need to do well for sports-domain research.
cells.G341: Use SVI-Bench-style tasks as an internal evaluation suite to stress-test GSE's own research agents' ability to autonomously gather and integrate cross-game evidence before trusting them with model/ensemble changes.

cells.C342: Betting Against Integrity: Identifying Match-Fixing Through In-Play Market Dynamics
cells.D342: Uses a state-space model of live-betting market dynamics on Italian Serie B data to detect statistically abnormal betting volume patterns indicative of match-fixing.
cells.E342: Models expected betting volume conditional on match characteristics via state-space methods, then applies outlier detection to flag deviations as potentially suspicious periods.
cells.F342: Highly relevant — anomaly detection on live odds/market data directly applies to GSE's live-odds pipeline (The Odds API) and its trust/compliance toolkit for integrity monitoring.
cells.G342: Build a match-fixing/anomaly early-warning layer into GSE's odds ingestion pipeline using this state-space + outlier-detection approach, adding an integrity-monitoring feature to the trust/compliance toolkit.

cells.C343: Simorgh at SemEval-2026 Task 7: Region-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Low-Resource Cultural Reasoning in Multilingual Question Answering
cells.D343: Proposes a hybrid BM25 plus dense-retrieval approach with regional weighting for culturally grounded multilingual QA, evaluated on a benchmark spanning domains including sports.
cells.E343: Combines lexical and semantic retrieval with regional heuristics to construct prompts for a quantized LLM with deterministic answer selection.
cells.F343: Not relevant — general multilingual cultural QA research; sports is only one of many topic domains in the underlying benchmark, no substantive connection to GSE.
cells.G343: No meaningful application to GSE's product.

cells.C344: Enabling Intelligent Bidirectional Charging: A Real-World Communication Interface Between EVs, Charging Infrastructure, and a Control Optimizer
cells.D344: Field-validates a real-world vehicle-to-grid bidirectional EV charging system with a multi-level communication architecture, deployed at a sports park in Dresden.
cells.E344: Integrates OBD-II vehicle data, a 5G middleware node, and OCPP-based communication to enable predictive, user-aware charging/discharging optimization.
cells.F344: Not relevant — EV charging infrastructure engineering; 'Sport Park' is merely the deployment site name, no substantive connection to GSE.

cells.C345: Dynamics Computation of Soft-Rigid Hybrid-Link System and Its Application to Motion Analysis of an Athlete Wearing Sport Prosthesis
cells.D345: Develops a hybrid rigid-flexible dynamics model to analyze motion and joint torques for an athlete using a flexible sports prosthesis.
cells.E345: Integrates a Piece-wise Constant Strain flexible-rod model with rigid-body inverse kinematics/dynamics to estimate ground reaction force and muscle force with amputation considered.
cells.F345: Not relevant — prosthetics biomechanics simulation, no connection to GSE's forecasting/calibration product.

cells.C346: A Constraint Programming Approach for n-Day Lookahead Playoff Clinching in the NHL
cells.D346: Develops a constraint-programming tree-search algorithm determining under which future game outcome combinations an NHL team will clinch a playoff spot, handling complex tie-breakers.
cells.E346: A custom tree search with pruning and node-ordering heuristics leverages a CP subroutine to infer playoff clinching/elimination scenarios n days into the future.

cells.G346: Use this CP-based clinching algorithm to auto-generate 'magic number' and playoff-scenario content/props across NFL/MLB/MLS, adding a deterministic, mathematically verifiable feature to GSE's content suite.

cells.C347: Synthesizing the Expert: A Validated Multimodal Dataset for Trustworthy AI-Assisted Swimming Coaching
cells.D347: Builds a multi-agent LLM framework generating a validated synthetic Q&A dataset grounded in physiological rules to power trustworthy retrieval-augmented AI swim coaching.
cells.E347: A multi-agent architecture synthesizes and validates 1,864 Question-Context-Answer triplets against 12 physiological soundness rules from a multimodal knowledge base.
cells.F347: Relevant — the multi-agent, rule-validated synthetic-data-generation pipeline is a strong pattern for GSE's own agent-driven tooling and its trust/compliance toolkit for verifiable AI outputs.
cells.G347: Adopt this rule-validated multi-agent synthetic-data pipeline to generate and audit synthetic settled-pick scenarios for stress-testing GSE's calibration models under sparse or edge-case conditions.

cells.C348: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark
cells.D348: Proposes an efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting method for synchronized multi-view dynamic scene rendering (e.g., sports), plus a reproducible Blender-based benchmark framework.
cells.E348: Initializes SfM-derived point clouds at the start time and propagates optimized Gaussians over time without explicit temporal deformation constraints, given calibrated multi-view input.

cells.G348: Could someday power immersive replay/visualization content for GSE's Galaxy Dynasty/AUGUR game layer if it incorporates broadcast-derived 3D scene reconstructions.

cells.C349: A Time-Synchronized Video Reference System for Data Analysis of Body-Attached Sensor Nodes in Outdoor Scenarios
cells.D349: Presents a lightweight GNSS-based timecode generator that synchronizes wearable sensor data with video reference recordings for outdoor sports/rehabilitation research.
cells.E349: Converts GNSS time to a Linear Timecode signal injected via camera audio channel, eliminating continuous wireless handshaking to save power in wearable sensor nodes.
cells.F349: Not relevant — wearable sensor synchronization hardware engineering, no connection to GSE's software/data product.

cells.C350: Tree-of-Text: A Tree-based Prompting Framework for Table-to-Text Generation in the Sports Domain
cells.D350: Proposes a tree-structured LLM prompting framework that generates sports game reports from structured tables (MLB, badminton, football) while reducing hallucination versus prior methods.
cells.E350: A three-stage process (content planning, operation execution on sub-tables, content generation/merging) breaks large tables into manageable pieces before generating a cohesive narrative report.

cells.G350: Deploy Tree-of-Text directly on GSE's own pick/grading tables to auto-generate accurate, low-hallucination recap and pick-rationale content at scale, feeding the automated content pipeline.

cells.C351: Phase-Separated Complex Hilbert PCA on Markerless 3D Pose Estimation Data
cells.D351: Applies Complex Hilbert PCA separately to backswing/downswing phases of hammer-throw motion, extracting a global whole-body phase pattern from markerless pose data.
cells.E351: A phase-separated CHPCA framework with automatic phase segmentation reveals trunk-anchored coordination patterns validated against continuous relative phase analysis.

cells.G351: No meaningful application beyond generic statistical dimensionality-reduction technique reuse.

cells.C352: From Skeletons to Pixels: Few-Shot Precise Event Spotting via Representation and Prediction Distillation
cells.D352: Proposes two multimodal distillation strategies (prediction-level and representation-level) that improve few-shot precise event spotting in tennis and figure skating video.
cells.E352: Adaptive Weight Distillation adaptively weights teacher supervision on unlabeled data, while Annealed Multimodal Distillation transfers skeleton knowledge into visual modalities via pseudo-labeling.
cells.F352: Weak thread — a few-shot sports event-detection computer-vision technique, tangential to GSE's core forecasting/calibration work.
cells.G352: Could inform low-data automated event-tagging for niche sports GSE might add later, using few-shot distillation to bootstrap event detectors without large labeled datasets.

cells.C353: Time-dependent Structural Equation Modeling of Fans' Football Fever Using Activity Tracking Data During the 2025 DFB Cup Final
cells.D353: Uses wearable heart-rate/stress data from football fans during a cup final to model 'football fever' as a latent, time-dependent process with a V-shaped trajectory across the match.
cells.E353: A time-dependent structural equation model with latent growth components and autoregressive effects captures overall trends and short-term carry-over in fans' physiological arousal.
cells.F353: Weak thread — fan physiological/emotional response modeling; tangential inspiration for latent time-dependent statistical modeling techniques or fan-engagement content timing, not core prediction.
cells.G353: Use a similar latent-growth time-dependent model of live win-probability swings to identify peak-excitement moments in a game for real-time content/notification triggering.

cells.C354: Parallel R-tree-based Spatial Query Processing on a Commercial Processing-in-Memory System
cells.D354: Maps R-tree spatial range queries onto commercial Processing-in-Memory (PIM) hardware, achieving up to 3.66x speedup and 3.4x lower energy versus CPU search, tested on a 'Sports' spatial dataset.
cells.E354: A broadcast-based method builds the R-tree on CPU and distributes filtering across DRAM Processing Units for parallel batched spatial range queries.
cells.F354: Not relevant — database hardware/systems research; 'Sports' is merely an incidental benchmark dataset name with no connection to GSE's product.
cells.G354: No meaningful application to GSE's Postgres/Prisma stack beyond the generic idea that specialized hardware could someday accelerate spatial queries if GSE added geospatial features.

cells.C355: The Pareto Principle in Sports and Economics in View of Runs Scored by Batters in the Indian Premier League
cells.D355: Uses IPL batter run distributions as a proxy for income/wealth inequality, finding seasonal and cumulative run inequality converges toward patterns resembling real-world economic inequality (Pareto principle).
cells.E355: Statistical distribution analysis treats single-season runs as 'income' and cumulative career runs as 'wealth,' tracking inequality evolution and its limiting Pareto-consistent value.
cells.F355: Relevant (adjacent) — heavy-tailed/Pareto distribution analysis of player performance is a useful statistical insight for GSE's cricket scoring models and understanding skewed performance outcomes generally.
cells.G355: Use Pareto/inequality metrics on player performance distributions as a feature to identify 'star-driven' versus 'balanced' teams, informing GSE's per-sport probability models with a distributional-shape signal.

cells.C356: Simulation of Adaptive Running with Flexible Sports Prosthesis Using Reinforcement Learning of Hybrid-link System
cells.D356: Uses reinforcement learning on a hybrid rigid-flexible dynamics model to simulate adaptive running motion for a transtibial amputee using a leaf-spring sports prosthesis.
cells.E356: Imitation learning from motion-capture data combined with a Piece-wise Constant Strain flexibility model simulates running dynamics under varying prosthetic stiffness, analyzing metabolic cost.
cells.F356: Not relevant — prosthetics biomechanics RL simulation research, no connection to GSE's core prediction/data product.

cells.C357: AI Driven Soccer Analysis Using Computer Vision
cells.D357: Builds an object-detection and tracking pipeline (YOLO/SAM2 plus homography) that converts soccer broadcast footage into real-world player positioning, speed, and heatmap data.
cells.E357: Combines player object detection/segmentation, keypoint-based field homography, and coordinate transformation to derive tactical statistics from standard video footage.
cells.F357: Relevant (adjacent) — a CV pipeline turning broadcast video into structured tactical data is a potential future ingestion source for GSE's soccer/MLS models, beyond current free scraped/box-score data.
cells.G357: Prototype a similar homography-based tracking pipeline on freely available match broadcasts to generate proprietary positional features that differentiate GSE's models from competitors using only box scores.

cells.C358: PlayGen-MoG: Framework for Diverse Multi-Agent Play Generation via Mixture-of-Gaussians Trajectory Prediction
cells.D358: Introduces a formation-conditioned multi-agent play-generation model using a shared Mixture-of-Gaussians output head, generating diverse realistic NFL plays from just an initial formation.
cells.E358: Non-autoregressive prediction of absolute displacements from initial formation, with relative spatial attention and shared-weight MoG heads, avoids error drift and mode collapse in generated trajectories.
cells.F358: Directly relevant — a diverse, mode-preserving generative trajectory model for NFL formations is applicable to improving GSE's underperforming forecasting model and generating scenario-based ensembles.
cells.G358: Use PlayGen-MoG-style scenario generation to produce multiple plausible game trajectories per matchup, feeding an ensemble of outcome forecasts that could improve both calibration and MAE versus the naive baseline.

cells.C359: Designing for Patient Voice in Interactive Health
cells.D359: Argues that patients' lived experience is treated as data rather than authored knowledge in interactive health research, proposing infrastructural pathways for patient-authored evidence, referencing sports medicine journals.
cells.E359: A design-probe methodology examines authorship norms, review criteria, and publication formats across medical journals including sports medicine to surface epistemic exclusion of patients.
cells.F359: Not relevant — health-research epistemics/publishing methodology paper; sports medicine is referenced only as one journal example, no connection to GSE.
cells.G359: No meaningful application to GSE's product.

cells.C360: Toward Personalized Darts Training: A Data-Driven Framework Based on Skeleton-Based Biomechanical Analysis and Motion Modeling
cells.D360: Builds a closed-loop motion-capture and feedback system for personalized dart-throwing training, using z-score deviation analysis against an individual's optimal trajectory.
cells.E360: Kinect-based markerless motion capture extracts 18 kinematic features, feeding a personalized optimal-trajectory model and a z-score-based deviation diagnosis/recommendation engine.
cells.F360: Not relevant — dart-throwing biomechanical coaching system, no connection to GSE's forecasting/calibration product.

cells.C361: The Load Management Paradox: Correcting the Healthy-Worker Survivor Effect in NBA Injury Modeling
cells.D361: Shows naive NBA injury models paradoxically find heavy recent minutes reduce injury risk due to healthy-worker survivor bias, and corrects this with a marginal structural piecewise-exponential model.
cells.E361: Combines inverse probability of treatment weighting with piecewise-exponential additive models and weighted cumulative exposure to remove collider bias from observational game-log injury data.
cells.F361: Highly relevant — a causal-inference (marginal structural model / IPTW) correction for selection bias directly parallels GSE's interest in rigorous causal methods (CEPT) and improves injury-risk features feeding predictions.
cells.G361: Apply this marginal-structural-model approach to correct selection bias in GSE's own injury/availability features, preventing the model from learning the same 'heavy minutes = lower risk' artifact that corrupts naive injury signals.

cells.C362: The Climber's Grip -- Personalized Deep Learning Models for Fear and Muscle Activity in Climbing
cells.D362: Combines EMG/ECG sensor data with mixed-effects and deep learning models to predict climbers' perceived fear from muscle fatigue and physiological signals.
cells.E362: Personalized deep learning with random effects captures nonlinear psychophysiological relationships between muscle activity and subjective fear ratings.
cells.F362: Tangential — the personalized random-effects modeling approach echoes GSE's suspected need for per-sport/per-player probability models instead of one global calibrator.
cells.G362: Borrow the personalized random-effects architecture as a template for per-athlete (not just per-sport) confidence adjustments within bootstrap mode.

cells.C363: EgoXtreme: A Dataset for Robust Object Pose Estimation in Egocentric Views under Extreme Conditions
cells.D363: Introduces a large egocentric 6D object pose dataset under extreme conditions (blur, low light, smoke) including a sports scenario, showing current pose estimators fail to generalize.
cells.E363: Benchmark dataset plus evaluation of state-of-the-art pose estimators and tracking-based methods under real-world visual degradation.
cells.F363: Weak stretch — mostly robotics/vision, but the robustness-under-noisy-conditions theme parallels GSE's need for pipelines that tolerate messy scraped/live data.
cells.G363: Use the extreme-condition robustness testing philosophy to stress-test GSE's odds/data scrapers against corrupted or partial feeds before they hit the model.

cells.C364: ParlayMarket: Automated Market Making for Parlay-style Joint Contracts
cells.D364: Proposes an automated market maker for correlated parlay/combo sports bets using a shared pairwise belief state, proving quadratic (not exponential) loss scaling, validated on Kalshi data.
cells.E364: A coherent joint probability distribution lets one liquidity pool price exponentially many parlay combinations from O(M^2) sufficient statistics.
cells.F364: Directly relevant — closing-line value and market efficiency are GSE's public accuracy standards; shows how correlated-outcome markets converge to a coherent joint probability.
cells.G364: Adapt the pairwise belief-state mechanism to jointly calibrate correlated same-game props instead of scoring each pick independently.

cells.C365: Simultaneous Estimation of Ballpark Effects and Team Defense Using Total Bases Residuals
cells.D365: Uses Statcast exit velocity/launch angle residuals to jointly estimate MLB ballpark effects and team defense, producing a standardized cross-team/season index.
cells.E365: Regression on total-bases residuals relative to an expected-outcome baseline separates park factors from fielding skill.
cells.F365: Directly useful for MLB modeling — a park-and-defense-adjusted expected-outcome baseline is exactly the per-sport feature engineering that could help close GSE's MAE gap to the naive baseline.
cells.G365: Build a park-and-defense-adjusted feature layer into GSE's MLB model so forecasts stop losing to the naive baseline on park-sensitive stats.

cells.C366: NFL step-and-turn: A generative framework for evaluating player movement in American football
cells.D366: Bayesian multilevel generative model of ball-carrier step length/turn angle enables posterior-predictive simulation of hypothetical player movement to build novel NFL performance metrics.
cells.E366: Frame-level generative simulation compares observed movement against many simulated alternative paths for counterfactual player evaluation.
cells.F366: Directly relevant — generative counterfactual simulation is a proper-scoring-rule-friendly way to build calibrated player-level probability features for NFL picks.
cells.G366: Use posterior-predictive alternative-path simulations to synthesize extra training scenarios that widen GSE's sparse-data NFL samples for bootstrap-mode confidence tightening.

cells.C367: A spatio-temporal graph-based model for team sports analysis
cells.D367: Introduces a generic directed-graph model of team-sport attacking play encoding spatial, temporal and semantic info, applied to rugby to test coaching/positioning hypotheses.
cells.E367: Ball-carrier-centered path graphs capture tactical sequences for cross-sport structural analysis.
cells.F367: Adjacent — a generalizable tactical graph representation could seed GSE's longer-term Intelligence Graph typed knowledge-primitives layer beyond simple stat features.
cells.G367: Prototype the Intelligence Graph's tactical layer using this directed-path graph schema, letting picks reference play-pattern nodes instead of only box-score stats.

cells.C368: ShuttleEnv: An Interactive Data-Driven RL Environment for Badminton Strategy Modeling
cells.D368: An RL simulation environment for badminton grounded in real match data, using probabilistic rally-dynamics models rather than physics, to train and visualize strategic agents.
cells.E368: Data-driven probabilistic rally simulator supports agent training and interactive strategy exploration without physics engines.
cells.F368: Stretch — closer to GSE's internal agentic tooling (Jarvis/Hermes/Fable) than to the prediction engine, but shows probabilistic rally modeling for a niche sport.
cells.G368: Repurpose the rally-simulation approach as a synthetic-data generator to backtest GSE's badminton/niche-sport models when historical data is too sparse for bootstrap mode.

cells.C369: NCAA Bracket Prediction Using Machine Learning and Combinatorial Fusion Analysis
cells.D369: Applies Combinatorial Fusion Analysis, combining multiple ranking systems via rank-score functions and cognitive diversity, to beat individual public rankings on 2024 NCAA bracket prediction (74.60% vs 73.02%).
cells.E369: Fuses diverse ranking systems by measuring their cognitive diversity and combining rank-score functions rather than simple averaging.
cells.F369: Directly relevant — an ensemble-fusion technique targeting diminishing returns from correlated rankings speaks to GSE's suspected need for an ensemble beyond a single global calibrator.
cells.G369: Use cognitive-diversity scoring to pick which of GSE's internal sub-models or external odds sources are truly complementary before folding them into the ensemble/CEPT framework.

cells.C370: Stepping VLMs onto the Court: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence in Sports
cells.D370: Introduces CourtSI, a 1M-QA spatial-intelligence benchmark for sports VLMs (badminton/tennis/table tennis), showing fine-tuning substantially closes the human-AI gap and improves commentary generation.
cells.E370: Court-geometry-anchored semi-automatic data engine creates spatial reasoning QA pairs to train/evaluate vision-language models.
cells.F370: Adjacent — mainly a VLM benchmark, but the improved spatial-aware commentary generation result is directly useful for GSE's automated social/media content ambitions.
cells.G370: Fine-tune a lightweight VLM on similar spatial QA data to auto-generate factually grounded pick commentary tied to court/field geometry, not just stat lines.

cells.C371: A global framework to estimate urban spatial cycling patterns based on crowdsourced data
cells.D371: Validates a POI/population-weighted framework for estimating urban cycling intensity from Strava's public Global Heatmap against real cycle counts across 29 cities.
cells.E371: Weights crowdsourced heatmap tile intensity by population and points-of-interest density, validated via correlation with ground-truth counts.
cells.F371: Tangential — not betting-related, but the pattern of validating a free crowdsourced data source against ground truth mirrors GSE's need to validate scraped multi-source sports data.
cells.G371: Apply the same weighting-and-validation methodology to sanity-check GSE's free scraped sources (e.g., Pro-Football-Reference) against paid odds-feed ground truth before ingestion.

cells.C372: Learning about Corner Kicks in Soccer by Analysis of Event Times Using a Frailty Model
cells.D372: Extends a prior corner-kick event-time model with a frailty term to capture within-team, within-game correlation, fit via Monte Carlo EM on 2019 Chinese Super League data.
cells.E372: Frailty (random-effects) survival model on right-censored event times captures unobserved team-level clustering in recurring event timing.
cells.F372: Directly relevant — frailty/random-effects survival modeling of correlated in-game events is a concrete technique for GSE's event-based sports data and in-game prop modeling.
cells.G372: Apply frailty models to GSE's in-game event streams (penalties, turnovers) to capture team-specific clustering a naive Poisson/logistic baseline misses.

cells.C373: AdaSpot: Spend Resolution Where It Matters for Precise Event Spotting
cells.D373: An adaptive-resolution video framework that spends compute on informative regions for precise sports event spotting, beating baselines on tennis/diving benchmarks with lower compute cost.
cells.E373: Unsupervised, task-aware region-of-interest selection processes high-resolution detail only where needed, avoiding uniform frame processing.
cells.F373: Stretch — computer-vision event spotting is adjacent to GSE's data pipeline only if it processes broadcast video; not core to the calibration/ensemble blockers.
cells.G373: If GSE ever ingests broadcast video for live props, use this adaptive-resolution approach to keep event-detection latency low for live line movement.

cells.C374: Iterative Closed-Loop Motion Synthesis for Scaling the Capabilities of Humanoid Control
cells.D374: Proposes a closed-loop automated pipeline generating diverse high-quality humanoid motion data (including sports) that iteratively raises policy difficulty ceilings beyond fixed motion-capture datasets.
cells.E374: Iterative generation-and-evaluation loop expands training data difficulty using physical metrics rather than a static motion-capture library.
cells.F374: Weak stretch — robotics motion synthesis, but the iterative closed-loop data-generation pattern parallels GSE's need to escape a model stuck losing to the naive baseline.
cells.G374: Borrow the iterative difficulty-escalation loop to systematically generate harder synthetic backtest scenarios that stress-test whether GSE's model truly beats naive baselines on edge cases.

cells.C375: Real-time Win Probability and Latent Player Ability via STATS X in Team Sports
cells.D375: Proposes a continuous T-score dominance indicator and time-evolving stochastic process for real-time win probability plus a latent player contribution index (STATS X) from cumulative box-score data.
cells.E375: Standardized cumulative statistics drive a sequential stochastic process yielding analytically tractable in-game win-probability updates and decomposed player contributions.
cells.F375: Highly relevant — essentially a live win-probability/player-attribution engine, directly applicable to GSE's core pick scoring and in-game confidence updates.
cells.G375: Adapt the T-process's sequential win-probability updating as the backbone for GSE's live confidence recalibration between pick proposal and lock, not just pregame scoring.

cells.C376: PerSoMed: A Large-Scale Balanced Dataset for Persian Social Media Text Classification
cells.D376: Releases a large balanced Persian social-media text classification dataset across nine categories (including Sports) and benchmarks transformer models, with TookaBERT-Large scoring highest.
cells.E376: Hybrid LLM-assisted and human-verified annotation with augmentation builds a balanced multi-class Persian NLP dataset.
cells.F376: Tangential — not sports prediction, but the dataset-construction methodology is a template for NLP-based brand-language enforcement if GSE ever needs non-English content moderation.
cells.G376: Reuse the balanced multi-category dataset construction recipe to build GSE's own AI-language-lint classifier training set for catching banned phrasing across languages.

cells.C377: Experimental Assortments for Choice Estimation and Nest Identification
cells.D377: Designs an O(n)-assortment experiment for choice-model estimation and a new algorithm to identify 'nests' of substitutable options in Nested Logit models, deployed at 70M-user scale on Dream11 fantasy sports.
cells.E377: Structured non-adaptive assortment experiments plus data-driven nest discovery improve choice-model estimation over ex-ante feature clustering.
cells.F377: Directly relevant — a real fantasy-sports platform's choice modeling and substitution-pattern discovery closely parallels how bettors choose among GSE's pick markets and contest types.
cells.G377: Apply nest-identification to GSE's own pick/contest catalog to discover which prediction markets are true substitutes, informing bundling and UI ordering.

cells.C378: Leicester's Tale: Another Perspective on the EPL 2015/16 Through Expected Goals (xG) Modelling
cells.D378: Builds a season-simulation framework converting shot-level xG data into probabilistic league table outcomes, showing Leicester's 2015/16 title was a low-probability but not fully detached statistical anomaly.
cells.E378: Simulates full seasons from shot-level xG to generate outcome-probability distributions, validated against actual final standings.
cells.F378: Directly relevant — a proper-scoring-rule-style validation of a probabilistic model against extreme real outcomes, exactly the kind of calibration-window testing GSE needs for its launch gate.
cells.G378: Use season-long xG-style simulation to pressure-test GSE's calibration gate against historically extreme outcomes rather than only average-case settled picks.

cells.C379: Making the complete OpenAIRE citation graph easily accessible through compact data representation
cells.D379: Compresses the 200M-publication, 2B-citation OpenAIRE graph from 2.5TB to 16GB RAM while preserving structure, with a reusable processing pipeline.
cells.E379: Data compaction and simplified representation pipeline makes a massive citation graph tractable on conventional hardware.
cells.F379: Tangential — pure data-engineering/graph-compression technique, relevant only as inspiration for GSE's own data-pipeline scale/reliability work, not sports-specific.
cells.G379: Apply similar graph-compaction techniques to GSE's own event/relationship graph (players-teams-games-picks) if the Intelligence Graph grows too large for cheap query infrastructure.

cells.C380: Generalizing Sports Feedback Generation by Watching Competitions and Reading Books: A Rock Climbing Case Study
cells.D380: Improves video-LLM sports feedback generation by using freely available web data (competition videos, coaching manuals) plus two new metrics (specificity, actionability) tailored to feedback quality, tested on rock climbing.
cells.E380: Cross-domain transfer from web-scraped auxiliary content boosts feedback generalization without expensive per-sport fine-tuning data.
cells.F380: Adjacent — directly useful for GSE's automated content generation, and its specificity/actionability metrics could define quality standards for pick explanations.
cells.G380: Adopt specificity and actionability as automated QA metrics for GSE's AI-generated pick rationale, catching vague or unhelpful auto-generated text before publishing.

cells.C381: Learning Human-Like Badminton Skills for Humanoid Robots
cells.D381: A progressive RL framework evolves a humanoid robot from motion-mimicry to functional badminton striking with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of shots like drop shots and lifts.
cells.E381: Reinforcement learning distills human motion priors into a compact state representation, using manifold expansion to generalize sparse expert strike demonstrations.
cells.F381: Weak stretch — robotics, essentially unrelated to GSE's prediction stack, though the sparse-demo generalization trick loosely echoes bootstrap-mode's sparse-data handling.
cells.G381: Borrow the manifold-expansion-from-sparse-demonstrations idea to generalize confidence estimates for rare bet types where GSE has few settled picks.

cells.C382: A Unified Server Quality Metric for Tennis
cells.D382: Develops Server Quality Scores isolating serve-specific tennis ability via logistic mixed-effects models with crossed server/returner random intercepts, outperforming weighted Elo for serve-efficiency prediction.
cells.E382: Partial-pooling logistic mixed-effects models with crossed random effects separate serve skill from returner and other latent factors.
cells.F382: Directly relevant — a concrete example of a per-skill, opponent-adjusted probability model that GSE could mirror when building sport-specific probability sub-models for its ensemble.
cells.G382: Use the crossed random-effects approach as a template for isolating skill-specific components (e.g., pitcher vs. batter) within GSE's per-sport probability models feeding the ensemble.

cells.C383: Sequences as Nodes for Contrastive Multimodal Graph Recommendation
cells.D383: A graph-based multimodal recommender combining collaborative, sequential, and text/visual signals via attention-pooled sequence nodes, outperforming baselines especially for cold-start/short-history users on Amazon Sports data.
cells.E383: Sequence-item graph propagation plus ID-guided gating fuses multimodal signals while reducing noise from raw data augmentation.
cells.F383: Tangential — a recommender-systems paper using 'Sports' as an Amazon product category name only, useful mainly for cold-start techniques applicable to GSE's new-user bootstrap mode.
cells.G383: Adapt the cold-start/short-history handling design to GSE's bootstrap-mode confidence capping for new leagues/players with thin historical data.

cells.C384: Neural Sabermetrics with World Model: Play-by-play Predictive Modeling with Large Language Model
cells.D384: Pretrains an LLM as a play-by-play world model on 3B tokens of 10+ years of MLB pitch-sequence data, predicting ~64% of next pitches and 78% of swing decisions.
cells.E384: Autoregressive LLM treats baseball games as long token sequences, learning a generative model of pitch-by-pitch game evolution.
cells.F384: Highly relevant — demonstrates LLM-style sequence modeling can outperform classical single-step baseball prediction, a candidate architecture for GSE's underperforming MLB forecasting model.
cells.G384: Pretrain a similar play-by-play sequence model on GSE's ingested MLB events to generate probabilistic pitch/at-bat trajectories, feeding richer features into the ensemble than static box scores.

cells.C385: Human-in-the-loop Adaptation in Group Activity Feature Learning for Team Sports Video Retrieval
cells.D385: Proposes human-in-the-loop fine-tuning for self-supervised group-activity video retrieval in team sports, using data-efficient active selection of videos to label without predefined activity classes.
cells.E385: Contrastive fine-tuning pulls user-labeled positive/negative retrieval examples closer/farther in an embedding space, guided by an efficient sample-selection strategy.
