cells.F812: Directly applicable to GSE's automated content generation ambitions — turning pick/odds/stats data into readable prediction write-ups without large labeled datasets.
cells.G812: Auto-generate the brand-compliant 'math you can read' pick explanations directly from scoring-engine output, enforcing the no-AI-language style as a downstream filter.

cells.C813: The incomplete Analytic Hierarchy Process and Bradley-Terry model: (in)consistency and information retrieval
cells.D813: Shows AHP pairwise-comparison models and the Bradley-Terry model yield identical priority vectors under consistency, and identifies optimal comparison subsets for small item sets.
cells.E813: Compares multiplicative/additive/reciprocal pairwise-comparison structures with Bradley-Terry/Thurstone stochastic ranking models.
cells.F813: Bradley-Terry-style pairwise models underlie sports team-strength ratings; optimal subset selection could inform which matchups GSE prioritizes modeling first.
cells.G813: Use the optimal-comparison-subset result to decide which limited cross-sport matchups to backtest first when validating a new per-sport probability model.

cells.C814: Filling the Gaps: A Multiple Imputation Approach to Estimating Aging Curves in Baseball
cells.D814: Uses multilevel multiple imputation to correct aging-curve estimates for MLB hitters that are biased by non-random dropout across careers.
cells.E814: Multiple imputation framework accounting for different missing-data (dropout) mechanisms in player performance panels.
cells.F814: Directly relevant to GSE's sparse-data 'bootstrap mode' and per-sport modeling — missing/short player histories bias performance projections the same way.
cells.G814: Apply the dropout-aware imputation method to fill gaps in scraped Pro-Football-Reference histories before feeding them into the prediction engine, reducing bootstrap-mode conservatism.

cells.D815: Introduces 'm-patterns' to formalize relationship structures in group collaborations (including sports teams) and compares empirical frequencies to a null hypergraph model.
cells.E815: Hypergraph structural-pattern analysis comparing observed collaboration networks to random null models.
cells.F815: Tangential — could inform an Intelligence Graph representation of team/player relationship structures, but not a core calibration or forecasting technique.
cells.G815: Use m-pattern analysis on roster/lineup co-occurrence data to detect chemistry effects (repeat-teammate patterns) as a feature for the ensemble models.

cells.C816: Fast and Robust Video-Based Exercise Classification via Body Pose Tracking and Scalable Multivariate Time Series Classifiers
cells.D816: Converts exercise videos into pose-derived multivariate time series and classifies exercise execution type with high accuracy and low compute cost.
cells.E816: Body pose tracking feeds a multivariate time-series classifier (BodyMTS) instead of end-to-end video deep learning.
cells.F816: Stretch — relevant only as a lightweight pattern for turning unstructured video/motion data into structured time-series features cheaply.
cells.G816: Adapt the pose-to-time-series pipeline for automatically tagging broadcast highlight clips for GSE's social content generation without expensive video models.

cells.C817: Characterizing the Structure of Online Conversations Across Reddit
cells.D817: Statistically analyzes global (subreddit) vs local (post) features driving the shape of Reddit discussion trees, finding sports subreddits produce deeper, wider threads.
cells.E817: Large-scale regression analysis of discussion-tree width/depth/size against community and post-level features.
cells.F817: Tangential inspiration for understanding fan engagement/discussion dynamics around GSE's picks and social content, not a modeling-engine technique.
cells.G817: Use similar tree-structure analytics on GSE's own community/comment threads to identify which pick types spark the most engaged discussion for content strategy.

cells.C818: VREN: Volleyball Rally Dataset with Expression Notation Language
cells.D818: Curates a large annotated volleyball rally dataset and descriptive language, enabling rally outcome and tactic prediction tasks.
cells.E818: Structured event-sequence dataset plus a domain-specific descriptive language for automated tactic/action analysis.
cells.F818: Illustrates the value of building sport-specific structured event schemas — directly analogous to GSE's need for per-sport data models feeding independent probability models.
cells.G818: Borrow the descriptive-language approach to standardize GSE's internal event taxonomy across NFL/MLB/MLS so per-sport models share a common feature schema.

cells.C819: ESTA: An Esports Trajectory and Action Dataset
cells.D819: Parses Counter-Strike server logs into a massive, clean trajectory/action dataset and builds win-prediction benchmarks from it.
cells.E819: Open-source log-parsing library (awpy) extracts granular spatiotemporal player trajectories and actions for modeling.
cells.F819: Directly relevant as a data-pipeline pattern — clean, granular event logs (vs. noisy scraped/video data) could improve GSE's win-probability model inputs.
cells.G819: Model GSE's own ingestion pipeline on awpy's log-parsing discipline to produce clean trajectory-like event features from odds/play-by-play feeds, improving MAE on the losing backtest.

cells.C820: KaliCalib: A Framework for Basketball Court Registration
cells.D820: An encoder-decoder network estimates basketball court keypoints from broadcast video to enable accurate court-to-image homography.
cells.E820: Perspective-aware keypoint regression with heavy data augmentation for camera calibration.
cells.F820: Peripheral — a computer-vision tracking technique, useful only if GSE ever ingests broadcast video rather than structured odds/stats data.
cells.G820: Could support a future 'live game overlay' B2B widget feature by enabling automated court-relative visualizations from broadcast feeds.

cells.C821: A Survey on the application of Data Science And Analytics in the field of Organised Sports
cells.D821: Surveys analytical tools and methodologies used across sports analytics, from player evaluation to outcome prediction and ticket marketing.
cells.E821: Literature review comparing algorithms/tools adopted across different sports analytics use cases.
cells.F821: Broadly relevant as a landscape reference for what techniques exist in sports analytics that GSE's engine could benchmark against or adopt.
cells.G821: Use the survey as a checklist to audit GSE's prediction-engine roadmap for gaps versus established sports-analytics methodology categories.

cells.C822: Data Science Approach to predict the winning Fantasy Cricket Team Dream 11 Fantasy Sports
cells.D822: Builds a regression model plus Greedy/Knapsack optimization to select the highest-expected-value fantasy cricket lineup on Dream11.
cells.E822: Player performance regression combined with combinatorial optimization (knapsack) under roster constraints.
cells.F822: Tangential — the optimization pattern (predict then optimize under constraints) parallels how GSE could optimize parlay/bet-slip construction from individual pick probabilities.
cells.G822: Adapt the knapsack-optimization layer to auto-construct optimal same-game parlays from GSE's per-pick probabilities and closing-line value estimates.

cells.C823: A Tale of HodgeRank and Spectral Method: Target Attack Against Rank Aggregation Is the Fixed Point of Adversarial Game
cells.D823: Formulates adversarial manipulation of pairwise-comparison rank-aggregation systems (like HodgeRank) as a game-theoretic fixed point and demonstrates targeted ranking attacks.
cells.E823: Game-theoretic adversarial perturbation of pairwise comparison data to manipulate rank-aggregation outputs.
cells.F823: Relevant as a security/robustness concern — GSE's ranking/rating systems built on pairwise comparisons (team strength models) could in principle be gamed by manipulated data.
cells.G823: Use this as a threat model for hardening GSE's data-ingestion pipeline against manipulated or poisoned odds/stat feeds that could skew team ratings.

cells.C824: A study on Urban Mobility in Northern Cities of Bangladesh
cells.D824: Assesses street/public-space allocation across Bangladeshi cities using GIS data, incidentally excluding sports facility space from its analysis.
cells.E824: GIS-based urban planning metric analysis of street layout and connectivity.
cells.F824: Not relevant to GSE's technical stack; only a nominal 'sports' mention (excluded from analysis) links it to the domain.
cells.G824: No meaningful application to GSE beyond noting it as an example of GIS/geospatial data pipelines, unrelated to prediction or calibration work.

cells.C825: Sporthesia: Augmenting Sports Videos Using Natural Language
cells.D825: A system that converts natural-language sports commentary into embedded visualizations synced with video, using NLP entity detection and visualization mapping.
cells.E825: Three-step pipeline: detect visualizable entities in text, map to visualization types, and schedule them against video timing.
cells.F825: Relevant to GSE's automated content-generation ambitions — turning textual pick commentary into visual/augmented content for social media.
cells.G825: Repurpose the text-to-visualization pipeline to auto-generate augmented highlight clips explaining why a pick was made, directly from the model's generated rationale text.

cells.C826: Needs and Challenges of Personal Data Visualisations in Mobile Health Apps: User Survey
cells.D826: Surveys mobile health app users on chart preferences and pain points, finding bar/pie charts favored and 'too much data' as a top complaint.
cells.E826: User survey analysis distilled into UI/UX design guidelines for personal data visualization.
cells.F826: Tangential UX inspiration for GSE's consumer-facing dashboards showing pick confidence, calibration, or performance history.
cells.G826: Apply the 'text+chart mix' and anti-clutter guidelines when designing GSE's public calibration/track-record dashboard meant to build trust without AI-hype framing.

cells.C827: Group Activity Recognition in Basketball Tracking Data -- Neural Embeddings in Team Sports (NETS)
cells.D827: A Transformer+LSTM model recognizes basketball group activities from player-tracking data, pretrained via self-supervised trajectory prediction to reduce labeling needs.
cells.E827: Self-/weak-supervised pretraining on trajectory prediction, fine-tuned for group activity classification.
cells.F827: Illustrates self-supervised pretraining to cut labeling cost — relevant if GSE later ingests player-tracking data for finer-grained in-game modeling.
cells.G827: Apply the self-supervised trajectory-pretraining trick to GSE's play-by-play/odds time series to build reusable embeddings across sports with limited labeled outcomes.

cells.C828: The Quest for Omnioculars: Embedded Visualization for Augmenting Basketball Game Viewing Experiences
cells.D828: Designs and evaluates embedded, in-broadcast visualizations (shooting, defense, comparison) to enhance fan understanding during live basketball games.
cells.E828: User-centered design framework mapping fan data-seeking contexts to targeted embedded visualization types.
cells.F828: Directly useful design inspiration for GSE's B2B embeddable widgets — a stated longer-horizon product ambition.
cells.G828: Build a live embeddable widget showing real-time closing-line-value and calibration context per pick, styled after Omnioculars' context-triggered visualization framework.

cells.C829: Automatic detection of faults in race walking from a smartphone camera: a comparison of an Olympic medalist and university athletes
cells.D829: Uses pose estimation plus ML trained on referee judgments to automatically and interpretably detect race-walking rule faults from ordinary smartphone video.
cells.E829: Pose estimation feeding a referee-judgment-trained classifier, validated against elite and amateur athletes.
cells.F829: Peripheral — a niche computer-vision application; only loosely tied to GSE's core statistical/calibration work.
cells.G829: Not a strong fit for GSE beyond illustrating how to train interpretable models against expert human judgments, which parallels validating pick confidence against human handicappers.

cells.C830: Using Conformal Win Probability to Predict the Winners of the Cancelled 2020 NCAA Basketball Tournaments
cells.D830: Applies conformal predictive distributions to generate calibrated win probabilities for the cancelled 2020 NCAA tournaments, outperforming regression baselines in calibration.
cells.E830: Conformal prediction (distribution-free, finite-sample valid) applied to single-game win probability estimation.
cells.F830: Directly relevant to GSE's failing calibration gate — conformal prediction offers a distribution-free alternative to standard calibrators that could reduce Brier/ECE.
cells.G830: Pilot conformal win probabilities as a per-sport calibration layer, since conformal methods give finite-sample coverage guarantees without needing the ensemble's full distributional assumptions.

cells.C831: ViT-ReT: Vision and Recurrent Transformer Neural Networks for Human Activity Recognition in Videos
cells.D831: Proposes lightweight Vision Transformer and recurrent Transformer architectures for faster, more scalable human activity recognition from video than CNN+RNN baselines.
cells.E831: Transformer-based spatial feature extraction combined with a recurrent transformer for temporal sequence modeling.
cells.F831: Peripheral — a video CV architecture; relevant only if GSE processes raw video for highlight generation rather than structured stats.
cells.G831: Could power automated highlight-clip tagging for GSE's social content pipeline if it ever ingests broadcast footage directly.

cells.C832: Towards Automated Key-Point Detection in Images with Partial Pool View
cells.D832: Presents an invariant keypoint model for swimming pools and studies keypoint detectability under partial camera views for swimmer tracking.
cells.E832: Pool-geometry keypoint model plus detectability analysis under occluded/partial camera framing.
cells.F832: Not relevant to GSE's core NFL/MLB/MLS/odds-driven stack; a narrow computer-vision problem for a sport outside their scope.
cells.G832: No meaningful application beyond illustrating robust keypoint detection under partial-visibility constraints, a pattern loosely relevant to noisy scraped data handling.

cells.C833: Sports Video Analysis on Large-Scale Data
cells.D833: Introduces the NSVA large-scale NBA video captioning dataset and a low-annotation-effort transformer pipeline for captioning, action recognition, and player identification.
cells.E833: Processes raw video into minimally-labeled feature stacks, then applies transformer cross-modeling for captioning/recognition tasks.
cells.F833: Relevant to GSE's automated content generation — captioning-style models could generate natural-language game summaries or pick rationales.
cells.G833: Fine-tune a captioning-style model on GSE's structured event data (not video) to auto-generate natural-language 'why this pick' narratives for published picks.

cells.C834: Heart rate estimation in intense exercise videos
cells.D834: Introduces a challenging dataset for video-based heart rate estimation during intense exercise with occlusion and motion, and a new spatio-temporal superpixel baseline.
cells.E834: Non-contact photoplethysmography via spatio-temporal superpixel analysis instead of face tracking.
cells.F834: Not relevant to GSE's stack; a biometric video-sensing problem unrelated to odds, calibration, or forecasting.
cells.G834: No meaningful application; at most illustrates handling severe noise/occlusion in a sensing pipeline, tangential to GSE's noisy scraped-data problem.

cells.C835: Dyadic Movement Synchrony Estimation Under Privacy-preserving Conditions
cells.D835: An ensemble deep-learning method estimates interpersonal movement synchrony (e.g., diving-team coordination) from privacy-preserving skeleton/optical-flow data rather than raw video.
cells.E835: Ensemble of deep networks trained on identity-agnostic secondary data (skeletons, optical flow) for synchrony scoring.
cells.F835: Tangential — ensembling identity-agnostic derived features is a data-privacy pattern GSE could reuse when scraping/publishing player-level data without exposing raw sources.
cells.G835: Apply the privacy-preserving derived-feature ensembling idea to publish team-chemistry/synchrony metrics without exposing proprietary scraped raw feeds.

cells.C836: RASIPAM: Interactive Pattern Mining of Multivariate Event Sequences in Racket Sports
cells.D836: An interactive system lets tennis/badminton experts inject domain knowledge as constraints into pattern-mining algorithms to discover tactics matching their intuition.
cells.E836: Constraint-based sequential pattern mining steered interactively by expert-provided natural-language suggestions.
cells.F836: Relevant as a human-in-the-loop pattern for incorporating founder/analyst domain knowledge into GSE's tactic/feature discovery rather than pure black-box mining.
cells.G836: Build an internal tool letting GSE analysts steer event-sequence pattern mining with plain-language constraints to surface interpretable, brand-safe 'math you can read' insights.

cells.C837: Bump hunting through density curvature features
cells.D837: Develops a rigorous curvature-based framework (mean curvature, Laplacian) for detecting meaningful modal 'bumps' in multivariate densities, illustrated on NBA/MLB/NFL data.
cells.E837: Plug-in kernel density estimation of curvature functionals with asymptotic consistency guarantees and confidence regions.
cells.F837: Directly relevant — a statistically rigorous exploratory tool for finding structure in sports performance distributions, useful for diagnosing where GSE's calibration is failing.
cells.G837: Use curvature-based bump hunting on residual/error distributions across sports to pinpoint which score ranges or sport-specific segments are driving the 0.2563 Brier score failure.

cells.C838: Graph Neural Networks to Predict Sports Outcomes
cells.D838: Introduces a sport-agnostic graph representation of game states fed to GNNs, improving outcome prediction loss by 9% (NFL) and 20% (esports) over feature-aggregation baselines.
cells.E838: Permutation-invariant graph neural network modeling of player interactions instead of hand-engineered spatial features.
cells.F838: Directly relevant to GSE's core backtest problem (losing to naive baseline) — GNN-based game-state modeling is a genuinely better forecasting method, not just more compute.
cells.G838: Prototype a GNN game-state model as one ensemble member feeding the multiplicative-weight CEPT ensemble, potentially closing the MAE gap versus the naive baseline.

cells.C839: Calibrate: Interactive Analysis of Probabilistic Model Output
cells.D839: Presents an interactive reliability-diagram tool for visually and instance-level analyzing classifier calibration, validated with data scientists on real and synthetic data, citing sports betting as a use case.
cells.E839: Interactive reliability diagrams with subgroup analysis and instance inspection, addressing aggregation drawbacks of static plots.
cells.F839: Direct hit — this is exactly the calibration-diagnosis tool GSE needs to investigate its failing Brier/ECE gate (0.2563/0.0699) at the subgroup (per-sport) level.
cells.G839: Deploy Calibrate internally as GSE's standard tool for diagnosing per-sport calibration drift before/after each of the three required consecutive green windows, catching subgroup miscalibration invisible in aggregate ECE.

cells.C840: Nutzungsverhalten und Funktionsanforderungen digitaler Trainingsanwendungen während der Pandemie
cells.D840: A German survey finds sporting activity declined through COVID lockdowns and identifies data-driven feedback and social/motivational features as most valued in digital training apps.
cells.E840: Survey-based analysis of digital fitness app usage and feature demand during pandemic restrictions.
cells.F840: Not relevant to GSE's prediction/calibration core; at most tangential UX input if GSE ever built a consumer fitness-adjacent feature.
cells.G840: No strong application; only loosely informs consumer engagement design for a hypothetical fitness-tracking extension of Galaxy Dynasty.

cells.C841: Machine Learning Modeling to Evaluate the Value of Football Players
cells.D841: Uses ML models to relate football player attributes and performance to salary as a proxy for market value, identifying key value-driving features.
cells.E841: Supervised regression on player features to predict salary/market value with feature-importance analysis.
cells.F841: Tangential — a valuation-modeling pattern distinct from GSE's win/outcome prediction focus, though methodologically similar (feature engineering + regression).
cells.G841: Adapt the salary-valuation feature-importance approach to build a transparent 'player value driver' explainer widget for GSE's B2B analytics offering.

cells.C842: College Spread of COVID-19 in Ohio
cells.D842: Statistically compares COVID-19 case growth in Ohio counties with vs without NCAA-sports colleges, finding significant differences in case increases.
cells.E842: Wilcoxon test comparison of epidemiological case-count trends across county groupings.
cells.F842: Not relevant to GSE's technical stack; an epidemiology study using college-sports presence only as a grouping variable.
cells.G842: No meaningful application to GSE's prediction/calibration engine.

cells.D843: Analyzes 120M+ chess games to characterize hot/cold performance streaks, opening diversity, and how skill level relates to behavioral consistency.
cells.E843: Large-scale behavioral/statistical analysis of streaks and strategic diversity using game-outcome sequences.
cells.F843: Tangential inspiration — streak/hot-hand analysis parallels questions GSE might ask about bettor or team performance persistence, useful for feature engineering.
cells.G843: Apply the hot/cold-streak quantification method to detect and feature-engineer momentum effects in team performance for the ensemble models.

cells.C844: Subjective and Objective Quality Assessment of High-Motion Sports Videos at Low-Bitrates
cells.D844: Conducts a large human-rated study of low-bitrate sports video quality across codecs, benchmarking objective VQA algorithms for bitrate-ladder design.
cells.E844: Human subjective scoring paired with objective video quality metric benchmarking for streaming optimization.
cells.F844: Not relevant to GSE's prediction engine; a video-streaming engineering problem outside their domain.
cells.G844: No meaningful application unless GSE builds its own live video streaming feature, in which case bitrate-ladder guidance could apply.

cells.C845: Overview of the Shared Task on Fake News Detection in Urdu at FIRE 2021
cells.D845: Reports on a shared task benchmarking Urdu fake-news classifiers across five domains including sports, showing declining performance versus prior years' test sets.
cells.E845: Binary classification benchmark comparing BoW/embedding features with classical ML and Transformer models (BERT/RoBERTa).
cells.F845: Tangential — a misinformation-detection benchmark; relevant only as a distant analogy to content-integrity checks GSE might apply to scraped/ingested sports news.
cells.G845: Repurpose fake-news-style classifiers to flag unreliable or fabricated stats sources in GSE's multi-source web-scraping pipeline before they reach the model.

cells.D846: Extends translation-synchronization ranking theory to time-varying settings, proposing smoothness-penalized and spectral estimators for tracking evolving team/player strength.
cells.E846: Least-squares and eigenspace-projection estimators recovering time-varying latent strength from a sequence of pairwise-comparison graphs.
cells.F846: Directly relevant — a rigorous method for dynamically updating team/player strength ratings over a season, applicable to GSE's per-sport probability models.
cells.G846: Use the smoothness-penalized dynamic ranking estimator as an alternative to ad-hoc Elo updates, giving GSE finite-sample error bounds on how fast team strength should be allowed to drift.

cells.C847: Predicting Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury in Rookie Major League Baseball Pitchers
cells.D847: A podium abstract exploring ML models to predict UCL (Tommy John) injury risk in rookie MLB pitchers from online pitcher data.
cells.E847: Supervised ML classification of injury risk from publicly available pitcher statistics.
cells.F847: Tangential — injury-risk prediction could feed as an auxiliary feature (pitcher availability/risk) into GSE's MLB probability models.
cells.G847: Add an injury-risk auxiliary model as a confidence-dampening input, similar to bootstrap mode, when a key pitcher shows elevated UCL risk signals.

cells.C848: Ranking with multiple types of pairwise comparisons
cells.D848: Presents an EM-based extension of the Bradley-Terry model that combines multiple, unknown-informativeness comparison types into a single ranking, applied to sports and animal dominance data.
cells.E848: Expectation-maximization algorithm learning latent weights for each comparison type within a modified Bradley-Terry framework.
cells.F848: Directly relevant — GSE could fuse multiple signal types (market odds, scraped stats, model outputs) into one ranking/rating using this exact EM+Bradley-Terry mechanism.
cells.G848: Use this as the mathematical backbone for the 'better ensemble' the founder wants — auto-learning how much to trust each data source (odds vs scraped stats vs CEPT e-process) per sport.

cells.C849: Prediction of Football Player Value using Bayesian Ensemble Approach
cells.D849: Optimizes a LightGBM ensemble with Bayesian hyperparameter tuning (TPE) and SHAP explainability to predict football transfer values, substantially beating baseline regressions.
cells.E849: Bayesian hyperparameter optimization of gradient-boosted ensembles plus SHAP-based interpretability.
cells.F849: Directly relevant methodological template — combines ensembling, principled hyperparameter search, and explainability, mirroring what GSE needs to fix its losing backtest and add interpretability.
cells.G849: Apply the TPE-optimized LightGBM + SHAP recipe as one candidate 'independent per-sport model' to test against the naive baseline the current engine is losing to.

cells.C850: Missing data patterns in runners' careers: do they matter?
cells.D850: Shows that explicitly modeling missing-season patterns (via a latent-class matrix-variate state space model) improves out-of-sample prediction of middle-distance runners' performance.
cells.E850: Latent-class matrix-variate state space model incorporating missingness patterns as informative signal.
cells.F850: Directly relevant to bootstrap mode — treating sparse/missing player data as informative (not just discarded) could improve confidence calibration for thin-data athletes/teams.
cells.G850: Fold 'missingness as signal' into bootstrap mode so sparse-data confidence caps become data-driven per missingness-pattern rather than a flat heuristic cap.

cells.C851: Doubly-online changepoint detection for monitoring health status during sports activities
cells.D851: Combines changepoint detection with Gaussian state-space models and an online EM/sequential Monte Carlo algorithm to detect distributional shifts across a runner's sequence of activities in real time.
cells.E851: Online EM with SMC approximation detecting both between-activity and within-activity distributional changepoints.
cells.F851: Directly relevant — an online, real-time changepoint framework applicable to GSE's BullMQ pipeline for detecting when a team/player's underlying performance distribution shifts (regime change) mid-season.
cells.G851: Wire this doubly-online changepoint detector into the data-ingestion job queue to auto-flag when a team's scoring distribution shifts, triggering a model re-calibration alert before it degrades the calibration gate.

cells.C852: Video Analytics in Elite Soccer: A Distributed Computing Perspective
cells.D852: Surveys real-time video analytics, GPS-tracking, and distributed computing approaches used in elite soccer performance analysis.
cells.E852: Literature review of IoT/wearable and distributed-computing architectures for sports video analytics pipelines.
cells.F852: Tangential — infrastructure-pattern reference for scaling data pipelines, loosely applicable to GSE's ingestion architecture but not analytics-specific.
cells.G852: Reference the distributed-computing patterns when scaling GSE's BullMQ/Redis pipeline to handle live multi-sport odds and event feeds concurrently.

cells.C853: Developing a Ranking Problem Library (RPLIB) from a data-oriented perspective
cells.D853: Introduces an open library of pairwise-comparison and feature-based ranking datasets and algorithms (linear ordering, Massey method) spanning sports and economics.
cells.E853: Curated dataset/algorithm library with model cards documenting optimal rankings for benchmarking ranking methods.
cells.F853: Directly useful as a benchmarking resource — GSE could validate its own rating/ranking submodels against RPLIB's known-optimal ranking datasets.
cells.G853: Use RPLIB's synthetic ranking datasets with known ground truth as a unit-test suite for GSE's ranking components, independent of noisy real sports outcomes.

cells.C854: SoccerCPD: Formation and Role Change-Point Detection in Soccer Matches Using Spatiotemporal Tracking Data
cells.D854: A two-step changepoint detection framework distinguishes intentional tactical formation/role changes from temporary fluctuations in soccer tracking data.
cells.E854: Role-assignment sequence changepoint detection separated from formation-level changepoint detection.
cells.F854: Relevant methodological analog to GSE's changepoint/regime-detection needs, though tied to spatial tracking data GSE doesn't currently ingest.
cells.G854: Adapt the two-step changepoint logic (temporary vs. tactical/intentional change) to distinguish noise from genuine regime shifts in team performance metrics feeding the calibration gate.

cells.C855: Machine Learning in Sports: A Case Study on Using Explainable Models for Predicting Outcomes of Volleyball Matches
cells.D855: Compares interpretable rule-based/logistic models with black-box SVM/DNN for volleyball match prediction, using ProtoDash and SHAP for post-hoc explanations validated by faithfulness metrics.
cells.E855: Two-phase pipeline: interpretable global models first, then post-hoc explanation (SHAP, prototypes) of black-box predictors.
cells.F855: Directly relevant to GSE's 'math you can read' brand promise — this is exactly the explainability pattern needed to justify predictions without claiming 'AI-powered'.
cells.G855: Use the faithfulness-validated SHAP/prototype explanation layer to auto-generate the human-readable rationale text that accompanies each published GSE pick.

cells.C856: Universal Behavior of Opponent Statistics and Applications to the MLB
cells.D856: Finds opponent-strength statistics follow a universal distribution across MLB teams, enabling a schedule-adjusted pitching metric (aFIP) via equipercentile equating.
cells.E856: Renormalizes player statistics against a hypothetical average opponent using a universal distributional transform.
cells.F856: Directly relevant — strength-of-schedule adjustment is exactly the kind of per-sport signal that could improve GSE's MLB probability model and reduce backtest MAE.
cells.G856: Build aFIP-style opponent-adjusted metrics as engineered features across all sports, giving each per-sport model a schedule-strength correction independent of the global calibrator.

cells.C857: Use of Kernel Density Estimation to understand the spatial trends of attacking possessions in rugby league
cells.D857: Applies KDE and Wasserstein distance to characterize and compare spatial attacking patterns between and within rugby league teams.
cells.E857: Continuous kernel density estimation of spatial event data compared via Wasserstein distance.
cells.F857: Tangential — a spatial-analytics method relevant only if GSE expands into tracking-data sports beyond its current odds/stats scope.
cells.G857: Could inform a future tactical-analysis feature for the Intelligence Graph, comparing spatial tendencies across opponents if positional data is ever ingested.

cells.C858: Explainable expected goal models for performance analysis in football analytics
cells.D858: Builds a large-scale, accurate expected-goals (xG) model and applies explainable AI (aggregated profiles) to interpret feature contributions for team/player evaluation.
cells.E858: Gradient-boosted xG model paired with explainable-AI aggregated-profile analysis of feature effects.
cells.F858: Directly relevant as a template for building an interpretable proper-scoring-rule-adjacent probability model (xG is a probability estimate) with post-hoc explainability, matching GSE's brand and calibration needs.
cells.G858: Build a GSE 'expected outcome value' model analogous to xG for non-soccer sports, paired with the same explainable-profile technique to generate transparent pick rationales.

cells.C859: Sports Re-ID: Improving Re-Identification Of Players In Broadcast Videos Of Team Sports
cells.D859: Proposes a hierarchical data-sampling procedure and centroid loss that substantially improve player re-identification accuracy in broadcast sports video with limited per-identity samples.
cells.E859: Centroid-based loss function combined with sampling that better matches training/test distributions for low-shot re-identification.
cells.F859: Not directly relevant to GSE's stats/odds-driven stack; a computer-vision re-identification problem for video-tracking pipelines they don't currently run.
cells.G859: No strong current application; would matter only if GSE built its own video-based player tracking rather than relying on third-party stats/odds feeds.

cells.C860: Evaluation of creating scoring opportunities for teammates in soccer via trajectory prediction
cells.D860: Uses a graph variational RNN to predict player trajectories and compares actual vs. predicted movement to score off-ball contributions, correlating significantly with player salary.
cells.E860: Graph-based variational recurrent trajectory prediction used as a counterfactual baseline for evaluating player movement value.
cells.F860: Tangential — a counterfactual/predicted-vs-actual evaluation pattern conceptually similar to using a baseline model to assess value-add, relevant to GSE's model validation philosophy.
cells.G860: Apply a similar predicted-vs-actual counterfactual framework to evaluate whether GSE's model additions beat the naive baseline in specific game situations, not just aggregate MAE.

cells.C861: A Survey on Video Action Recognition in Sports: Datasets, Methods and Applications
cells.D861: Surveys video action-recognition datasets and methods across ten-plus sports, and releases a PaddlePaddle toolbox for football/basketball/table-tennis/figure-skating recognition.
cells.E861: Comprehensive review plus a practical open-source toolbox implementation of sports action recognition models.
cells.F861: Peripheral to GSE's current stats/odds-based stack; relevant only if they pursue video-derived features for the Intelligence Graph.
cells.G861: Reference the open toolbox if GSE ever needs to bootstrap action-recognition features cheaply rather than building from scratch.

cells.C862: DGSVis: Visual Analysis of Hierarchical Snapshots in Dynamic Graph
cells.D862: Proposes a human-in-the-loop snapshot-generation algorithm and visual analytics tool for exploring large, time-varying dynamic graphs, demonstrated on basketball player networks.
cells.E862: Multi-granularity hierarchical snapshotting of dynamic graphs with an interactive visual analysis system.
cells.F862: Tangential — relevant as a possible visualization approach for exploring GSE's future Intelligence Graph as it evolves temporally.
cells.G862: Use the hierarchical snapshot technique to let analysts visually audit how the Intelligence Graph's typed relationships evolve across a season.

cells.C863: Athlete rating in multi-competitor games with scored outcomes via monotone transformations
cells.D863: Proposes a Bayesian dynamic linear model with learned monotone transformations to estimate time-varying athlete ability from non-normally distributed game scores across Olympic sports.
cells.E863: Bayesian state-space model with flexible monotone response transforms fit via standard regression/optimization routines.
cells.F863: Directly relevant — a rigorous Bayesian time-varying rating method for non-normal score data, applicable to building GSE's independent per-sport probability models.
cells.G863: Use the monotone-transform Bayesian dynamic model as a candidate ensemble member specifically for sports where GSE's global calibrator's normality assumption is failing worst.

cells.C864: How Much Does Home Field Advantage Matter in Soccer Games? A Causal Inference Approach for English Premier League Analysis
cells.D864: Develops a hierarchical causal model to estimate league- and team-level causal effects of home field advantage on offensive, defensive, and referee-related outcomes in the EPL.
cells.E864: Hierarchical causal inference model with an identifiability proof and inference procedure for team-specific treatment effects.
cells.F864: Directly relevant — a rigorous causal-inference case study on a classic sports covariate (home advantage), directly applicable to feature engineering and the CEPT causal framework GSE wants to leverage.
cells.G864: Use this hierarchical causal design as a template to causally isolate other confounded sports factors (rest days, travel, weather) before feeding them into GSE's ensemble, rather than treating them as naive features.

cells.C865: Nonconvex L1/2-Regularized Nonlocal Self-similarity Denoiser for Compressive Sensing based CT Reconstruction
cells.D865: Develops a nonconvex regularized denoising method for compressive-sensing CT image reconstruction using low-rank group sparse coding and ADMM optimization.
cells.E865: Nonconvex L1/2-norm regularization combined with nonlocal self-similarity denoising for medical image reconstruction.
cells.F865: Not relevant — a medical imaging/compressive sensing paper with no connection to sports, prediction, or GSE's product.
cells.G865: No honest application to GSE beyond the generic optimization technique (ADMM) being a general numerical method occasionally useful in model fitting.

cells.C866: IMU Based Deep Stride Length Estimation With Self-Supervised Learning
cells.D866: A CNN pretrained self-supervised on unlabeled IMU data then fine-tuned on a small labeled set predicts running/walking stride length and gait type with improved accuracy over prior methods.
cells.E866: Self-supervised pretext-task pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning for regression/classification on IMU sensor data.
cells.F866: Tangential — the self-supervised-then-fine-tune pattern is broadly reusable for GSE's own sparse-labeled-data problems, but the domain (wearable sensors) doesn't map to GSE's stats/odds stack.
cells.G866: Apply the self-supervised pretrain/fine-tune pattern to GSE's large volume of unlabeled scraped stats, pretraining representations before fine-tuning on the smaller labeled settled-picks set.

cells.C867: Characterizing player's playing styles based on Player Vectors for each playing position in the Chinese Football Super League
cells.D867: Uses nonnegative matrix factorization on spatially-informed event data to discover 18 distinct playing styles by position in the CSL.
cells.E867: Two-stage NMF: first builds per-match player vectors, then factorizes those vectors to extract latent style archetypes.
cells.F867: Tangential — a style/archetype discovery technique that could enrich GSE's player/team feature set beyond box-score stats, feeding richer per-sport models.
cells.G867: Use NMF-derived playing-style archetypes as categorical features in GSE's ensemble to capture stylistic matchup effects that raw stats miss.

cells.C868: A Multi-stage deep architecture for summary generation of soccer videos
cells.D868: Generates soccer match highlight summaries by combining audio and event metadata rather than raw video content, with strong cross-dataset generalization.
cells.E868: Multi-modal (audio + event metadata) deep pipeline detecting and ranking candidate highlight moments.
cells.F868: Directly relevant to GSE's automated social/media content generation ambitions — event-metadata-driven summarization avoids costly raw video processing.
cells.G868: Use event-metadata-only summarization to auto-generate short recap clips/text for graded picks, letting content automation scale without licensing broadcast video.

cells.C869: PGD: A Large-scale Professional Go Dataset for Data-driven Analytics
cells.D869: Releases a large professional Go dataset with AlphaZero-evaluated move quality and demonstrates a results-prediction system achieving much higher accuracy than prior baselines.
cells.E869: Curated dataset with AI-evaluated move features feeding a supervised prediction benchmark.
cells.F869: Tangential — demonstrates the value of augmenting raw outcome data with a strong evaluator model's move-quality signal, conceptually similar to using model-derived features to boost prediction accuracy.
cells.G869: Analogous idea: have GSE's own ensemble score historical plays/events with quality/context ratings, then use those derived ratings as richer features for future predictions rather than raw box scores.

cells.C870: A Validation Procedure for the Estimation of Reachable Regions in Football
cells.D870: Proposes and tests a validation routine for player-motion models in soccer, finding a two-segment constant-speed model most accurately predicts reachable positions versus constant-speed/acceleration models.
cells.E870: Optimizes motion-model accuracy by minimizing predicted reachable-area size while covering observed positions, tested across four kinematic models.
cells.F870: Tangential — a rigorous model-validation methodology (favor smallest area covering observations) parallels the discipline GSE needs when validating its own probability/uncertainty models.
cells.G870: Borrow the 'smallest region covering observed outcomes' validation criterion as a sanity check for GSE's confidence intervals/bootstrap-mode uncertainty bounds.

cells.C871: PoseCoach: A Customizable Analysis and Visualization System for Video-based Running Coaching
cells.D871: A customizable pose-analysis system lets users define running-form attributes and visualizes pose differences between novice and expert runners as 3D animations.
cells.E871: User-configurable pose-attribute analysis with viewpoint-independent 3D difference visualization.
cells.F871: Not directly relevant to GSE's prediction stack; a coaching-feedback visualization tool for a different product category.
cells.G871: No strong application beyond general UX inspiration for customizable, comparison-based visualization interfaces.

cells.C872: Semi-Supervised Training to Improve Player and Ball Detection in Soccer
cells.D872: Uses a teacher-student semi-supervised approach with confidence-aware loss to improve player/ball detection using large unlabeled broadcast video alongside small labeled sets.
cells.E872: Teacher-student self-training with confidence-weighted loss parametrizations to leverage unlabeled data.
cells.F872: Tangential — a semi-supervised training pattern generally useful for GSE's data-scarce sub-problems, though the CV detection task itself doesn't map to their stats-based stack.
cells.G872: Apply the teacher-student confidence-weighted self-training pattern to GSE's own sparse-labeled settled-picks data, using the current model as 'teacher' to pseudo-label larger unlabeled historical datasets.

cells.C873: Twin-in-the-loop state estimation for vehicle dynamics control: theory and experiments
cells.D873: Proposes a digital-twin-based state estimator for vehicle dynamics, tuned via Bayesian optimization, validated on a sports car dataset, outperforming traditional Kalman filtering.
cells.E873: Digital twin simulator coupled with a data-driven compensator inside a closed-loop observer, tuned by Bayesian optimization.
cells.F873: Not relevant to GSE's core stack — an automotive control-systems paper whose 'sports car' reference is incidental, not sports-analytics related.
cells.G873: No honest application beyond the generic Bayesian-optimization tuning technique being reusable for any black-box model calibration task.

cells.D874: Surveys conventional and deep-learning methods for optical player/ball tracking in team sports, covering preprocessing, challenges, and downstream analytics applications.
cells.E874: Taxonomy and comparison of computer-vision tracking methods by cost and limitations for sports data collection.
cells.F874: Peripheral — a tracking-technology survey relevant only if GSE moves beyond odds/box-score data into positional tracking data ingestion.
cells.G874: Use the taxonomy to evaluate build-vs-buy options if GSE later wants to license or build tracking-derived features for its Intelligence Graph.

cells.C875: Efficient tracking of team sport players with few game-specific annotations
cells.D875: Combines pretrained detection/re-ID networks with incremental Transformer-based identity classification to track rugby sevens players using minimal per-game human annotation.
cells.E875: Semi-interactive tracklet generation plus incremental learning to minimize game-specific labeling effort.
cells.F875: Tangential — an annotation-efficiency pattern broadly useful if GSE's data pipeline requires human-verified labels for new sports/leagues.
cells.G875: Apply the low-annotation incremental-learning pattern to bootstrap new-league or minor-sport data ingestion with minimal manual QA effort.

cells.C876: Collecting, Classifying, Analyzing, and Using Real-World Elections
cells.D876: Compiles 7,582 real-world election-like datasets (including sports rankings) and analyzes their structural properties against social choice theory benchmarks.
cells.E876: Large-scale collection and structural analysis (single-peakedness, Condorcet paradox frequency) of ranking/preference datasets.
cells.F876: Tangential — sports rankings appear as one election-like data source; relevant mainly as a benchmark corpus for testing ranking-aggregation algorithms GSE might use.
cells.G876: Use the election-dataset corpus to stress-test GSE's ranking/rating aggregation logic against known pathological cases like Condorcet cycles.

cells.C877: Detecting key Soccer match events to create highlights using Computer Vision
cells.D877: Compares Faster R-CNN and YOLOv5 for detecting key soccer events from video, using the better-performing Faster R-CNN (ResNet50) to auto-generate condensed match highlights.
cells.E877: Object-detection-based event spotting in video, condensing a full match into an automatically extracted highlight reel.
cells.F877: Relevant to GSE's automated content-generation ambitions if they process video, though their stack is currently stats/odds-driven rather than video-driven.
cells.G877: Could support future licensed-video highlight automation for GSE's social content pipeline, once/if video ingestion is added to the stack.

cells.C878: Enhancing Digital Health Services: A Machine Learning Approach to Personalized Exercise Goal Setting
cells.D878: Uses deep reinforcement learning (A3C) on time-series exercise data to dynamically personalize daily exercise-intensity goals accounting for fitness-fatigue effects.
cells.E878: Asynchronous advantage actor-critic reinforcement learning over time-series behavioral data for adaptive goal-setting.
cells.F878: Not directly relevant to GSE's prediction engine; a consumer health/fitness RL application outside their sports-prediction domain.
cells.G878: Conceptually transferable RL pattern — could inform an adaptive user-engagement feature (e.g., personalized pick-difficulty/stakes suggestions) in the Galaxy Dynasty game layer.

cells.C879: Time Dependency, Data Flow, and Competitive Advantage
cells.D879: Studies how the predictive value of Reddit text data decays over time across topics (including sports), arguing that fast-decaying domains favor continuous data flow over static data stockpiles for competitive advantage.
cells.E879: Measures relevance-decay rates of user-generated text for algorithmic next-word prediction across subreddit topics.
cells.F879: Directly relevant to GSE's data pipeline strategy — sports data likely decays fast, reinforcing the importance of continuous live odds/event ingestion over static historical stockpiles.
cells.G879: Quantify GSE's own per-sport data-decay rates to decide how aggressively to weight recent vs. historical data in each sport's probability model, potentially explaining part of the calibration failure.

cells.C880: Bayesian Analysis of Formula One Race Results: Disentangling Driver Skill and Constructor Advantage
cells.D880: A Bayesian multilevel rank-ordered logit model separates F1 driver skill from constructor (car) advantage, finding ~88% of race-result variance is explained by the constructor.
cells.E880: Bayesian multilevel rank-ordered logit regression decomposing performance into hierarchical skill and team-level components.
cells.F880: Directly relevant — a rigorous Bayesian hierarchical model for decomposing individual vs. systemic contributions to outcomes, directly applicable to GSE's per-sport probability modeling (e.g., separating player skill from team/system effects).
cells.G880: Adapt the hierarchical decomposition to separate 'team system' effects from 'individual player' effects in GSE's models, giving more interpretable, brand-appropriate 'math you can read' explanations of why a pick was made.

cells.C881: A Supervised Learning Approach to Rankability
cells.D881: Reviews existing rankability measures (how meaningfully a pairwise-comparison dataset can be ranked) and proposes new, efficiently estimable supervised alternatives, tested on real sports data.
cells.E881: Supervised learning models predicting rankability scores as a cheaper alternative to combinatorial/linear-algebraic rankability measures.
cells.F881: Directly relevant — rankability assessment could help GSE decide when a sport/league's data is too sparse or noisy to support confident predictions, directly informing bootstrap mode.
cells.G881: Use a rankability score as an automated gate: sports/leagues below a rankability threshold get routed into bootstrap mode's confidence cap rather than full model output.

cells.C882: SuperCone: Unified User Segmentation over Heterogeneous Experts via Concept Meta-learning
cells.D882: Presents a 'super learning' system combining structurally incompatible model architectures into a unified ensemble for long-tail user-segment prediction tasks, outperforming standard ranking baselines.
cells.E882: Meta-learning framework that adaptively attends over heterogeneous expert models plus deep concept representations.
cells.F882: Directly relevant to the founder's ensemble goal — a concrete architecture for combining incompatible model types (e.g., CEPT e-process, per-sport models, market-based signals) into one system.
cells.G882: Use SuperCone's heterogeneous-expert attention mechanism as the technical blueprint for the CEPT multiplicative-weight ensemble, letting GSE combine structurally different models per sport without forcing a common architecture.

cells.C883: Soccer: a quantitative analysis of team resilience and the miracle of Bern
cells.D883: Defines and measures soccer team resilience (comeback rate from 2-goal deficits) across 59 Bundesliga seasons, comparing empirical data to a Poisson-based theoretical model.
cells.E883: Poisson-distribution-based theoretical model benchmarked against empirical comeback-frequency data.
cells.F883: Tangential — illustrates using a simple probabilistic baseline (Poisson) to interpret an empirical sports phenomenon, relevant as a modeling-discipline example for GSE's own baseline comparisons.
cells.G883: Compute a similar 'resilience index' as a novel feature (teams that overperform their Poisson-expected comeback rate) to enrich GSE's per-sport models.

cells.C884: SUPERNOVA: Automating Test Selection and Defect Prevention in AAA Video Games Using Risk Based Testing and Machine Learning
cells.D884: An ML-driven system for risk-based test selection and defect prediction in AAA game production, cutting testing hours 55%+ on a shipped sports game title.
cells.E884: Semi-supervised ML risk-scoring model predicting bug-inducing changelists, integrated as an automation hub for QA.
cells.F884: Relevant to GSE's own engineering practices — risk-based automated testing could reduce QA burden on the prediction-engine and data-pipeline codebase, especially given their autonomous coding agents.
cells.G884: Have GSE's internal coding agents (Jarvis/Hermes/Fable) use a SUPERNOVA-style risk model to prioritize which code changes need the most rigorous test/backtest scrutiny before deployment.

cells.C885: Personal Data Visualisation on Mobile Devices: A Systematic Literature Review
cells.D885: A systematic review of 29 studies on personal data visualization (including sports/fitness data) finds no established best practices or assessment frameworks for mobile data viz.
cells.E885: Systematic literature review synthesizing gaps across personal-data visualization studies.
cells.F885: Tangential UX research relevant to designing GSE's consumer-facing mobile dashboards for pick tracking and calibration transparency.
cells.G885: Use the review's identified gaps (no assessment framework) as a rationale to pioneer a rigorous, user-tested mobile calibration/track-record visualization for GSE's trust/compliance toolkit.

cells.C886: Knock, knock. Who's there? -- Identifying football player jersey numbers with synthetic data
cells.D886: Shows that adding synthetic training images substantially improves jersey-number detection accuracy on a small, imbalanced real NFL practice-video dataset.
cells.E886: Synthetic data augmentation combined with a simple detection model to address class imbalance in jersey-number recognition.
cells.F886: Tangential — illustrates using synthetic data to address class imbalance/sparsity, a pattern potentially useful for GSE's sparse per-sport settled-pick datasets.
cells.G886: Generate synthetic settled-pick scenarios (via simulation) to augment thin-data sports/leagues, supporting the independent per-sport calibration models the founder wants.

cells.C887: Simple mechanism rules the dynamics of volleyball
cells.D887: Derives a closed-form stochastic model for the number of hits in a volleyball rally from two variables, matching empirical data from 20 professional games.
cells.E887: Parsimonious stochastic (probabilistic) model of rally dynamics validated against real match data.
cells.F887: Tangential — a good example of a simple, interpretable probabilistic model outperforming complexity, aligned with GSE's 'math you can read' philosophy.
cells.G887: Use this as a design principle: prioritize simple closed-form stochastic models per sport where they suffice, reserving the heavier ensemble/CEPT machinery for genuinely complex cases.

cells.C888: Predictive simulation of single-leg landing scenarios for ACL injury risk factors evaluation
cells.D888: Uses musculoskeletal predictive simulation to identify biomechanical parameters (landing height, joint rotation, muscle forces) associated with ACL injury risk during single-leg landings.
cells.E888: Computational musculoskeletal predictive simulation exploring risk-factor sensitivity without needing new experimental data.
cells.F888: Not relevant to GSE's stats/odds prediction stack; a biomechanics/injury-simulation study outside their domain.
cells.G888: No meaningful application beyond illustrating simulation-based sensitivity analysis as a general technique.

cells.C889: Learning from the Pros: Extracting Professional Goalkeeper Technique from Broadcast Footage
cells.D889: Uses unsupervised learning on 3D pose data extracted from broadcast footage to learn professional goalkeeper technique and build an 'expected saves' model.
cells.E889: Unsupervised clustering of pose-derived technique features combined with an expected-value (expected saves) model.
cells.F889: Tangential — the 'expected saves' probability-modeling pattern is conceptually similar to expected-goals-style proper-scoring-rule modeling GSE could use, though the pose-extraction part isn't applicable.
cells.G889: Borrow the 'expected X' probabilistic-outcome framing pattern (like expected saves/goals) to build additional interpretable sub-metrics per sport that feed GSE's ensemble.

cells.C890: Domain Adaptation in Neural Machine Translation using a Qualia-Enriched FrameNet
cells.D890: Proposes Scylla, a FrameNet-based domain-adaptation method for machine translation that avoids fine-tuning, evaluated partly on Sports-domain sentences, beating a commercial baseline.
cells.E890: Frame-semantic knowledge base injection into NMT decoding to adapt translation without retraining the base model.
cells.F890: Tangential — relevant only if GSE needs multilingual localization of pick content; the underlying frame-based domain-adaptation idea is a stretch fit.
cells.G890: Could support future localization of GSE's automated pick commentary into other languages without retraining core generation models, using frame-based domain adaptation.

cells.C891: Causal inference with recurrent and competing events
cells.D891: Formalizes causal estimands for treatment effects on recurrent outcomes (e.g., sports injuries) when a competing event like death can preclude further recurrences, using causal DAGs and SWIGs.
cells.E891: Formal causal-inference framework (mediation, direct/total effects) for recurrent events under competing risks, in both discrete and continuous time.
cells.F891: Directly relevant to the founder's causal-inference ambitions (CEPT) — this formalizes exactly the kind of rigorous causal estimand definitions needed to make e-process/causal claims defensible.
cells.G891: Use this recurrent/competing-events framework to formally define what 'winning' means causally in multi-leg parlays or repeated-bet scenarios where one outcome can preclude others.

cells.C892: A quantitative method for benchmarking fair income distribution
cells.D892: Constructs a fairness benchmark for income distribution using professional sports salary-allocation norms (rule-based, performance-based, luck-based) as the reference model.
cells.E892: Benchmark derived from sports-compensation fairness norms applied to national income-distribution (Gini) data via the World Bank dataset.
cells.F892: Tangential — uses sports salary fairness as an analogy/reference point for economic policy, not directly about prediction/calibration.
cells.G892: No strong application to GSE's engine; at most a philosophical framing device for discussing 'fair' payout structures in the Galaxy Dynasty game economy.

cells.C893: A Statistical Model of Serve Return Impact Patterns in Professional Tennis
cells.D893: Develops a Bayesian 'latent style allocation' mixture model to characterize professional tennis players' return-impact locations more flexibly than standard finite Gaussian mixtures.
cells.E893: Bayesian mixture-of-mixtures model where latent player styles are themselves finite Gaussian mixture members.
cells.F893: Directly relevant — a sophisticated Bayesian mixture modeling approach for capturing player-level heterogeneity, applicable to building richer per-sport (tennis) probability models beyond a single global calibrator.
cells.G893: Adapt the latent-style-allocation mixture approach to model heterogeneous 'player archetypes' as sub-populations within GSE's per-sport ensemble, rather than assuming one distribution fits all players.

cells.C894: A physics-driven study of dominance space in soccer
cells.D894: Extends Voronoi-diagram dominance-space models in soccer with asymmetric player influence and frictional-force kinematics, producing more realistic, non-convex dominance regions.
cells.E894: Physics-based kinematic extension (asymmetric influence, friction) of Voronoi dominance-area computation.
cells.F894: Not directly relevant to GSE's current odds/stats stack; a spatial-tracking analytics method requiring positional data they don't currently ingest.
cells.G894: Would only matter if GSE later ingests player-tracking data for a soccer-specific tactical feature within the Intelligence Graph.

cells.C895: GNNRank: Learning Global Rankings from Pairwise Comparisons via Directed Graph Neural Networks
cells.D895: Introduces a trainable GNN framework with digraph embedding and Fiedler-vector-based inductive bias for recovering global rankings from pairwise comparison data, outperforming baselines with transfer ability.
cells.E895: Graph neural network on directed comparison graphs, unfolding a spectral (Fiedler vector) computation as an inductive bias, with new ranking-violation objectives.
cells.F895: Directly relevant — a state-of-the-art ranking-from-pairwise-comparisons method directly applicable to GSE's team/player strength ranking submodels, with demonstrated transfer across domains.
cells.G895: Pilot GNNRank as a candidate team-strength ranking model whose transfer ability could let GSE bootstrap ranking quality in sparse-data sports using patterns learned from data-rich ones.

cells.C896: LTC-GIF: Attracting More Clicks on Feature-length Sports Videos
cells.D896: Proposes a lightweight, on-device method to generate personalized thumbnails and GIFs from full-length sports videos by processing small segments rather than entire videos.
cells.E896: Lightweight thumbnail-container analysis on client devices to personalize artistic media generation efficiently.
cells.F896: Relevant to GSE's content-automation and social-media generation ambitions — efficient personalized media generation could power engagement-optimized pick promotion content.
cells.G896: Adapt the lightweight personalized-thumbnail approach to auto-generate eye-catching, personalized social snippets for each published pick without heavy video-processing costs.

cells.C897: Physical Activity Recognition by Utilising Smartphone Sensor Signals
cells.D897: Classifies human physical activities (walking, stairs, sitting) from smartphone gyroscope/accelerometer data using majority-vote ML ensembles, achieving 98% accuracy.
cells.E897: Time/frequency-domain feature extraction combined with majority-voting ensemble classification.
cells.F897: Tangential — the majority-vote ensembling pattern is a simple analog to the multiplicative-weight ensembling GSE's CEPT approach targets, though the sensor-data domain doesn't map directly.
cells.G897: No strong direct application beyond illustrating a simple, low-cost majority-vote ensemble baseline GSE could sanity-check its more complex CEPT ensemble against.

cells.C898: RunnerDNA: Interpretable indicators and model to characterize human activity pattern and individual difference
cells.D898: Defines five interpretable indicators (balance, stride, steering, stability, amplitude) from smartphone sensors to distinguish individual movement styles and recognize activities/users.
cells.E898: Interpretable feature-engineering framework plus random forest models for activity and identity recognition.
cells.F898: Tangential — the interpretable-indicator design philosophy aligns with GSE's 'math you can read' brand, though the wearable-sensor domain is distant from their stats/odds stack.
cells.G898: Borrow the design philosophy (a small set of interpretable, named indicators) when designing GSE's public-facing model explainability features, avoiding black-box impressions.

cells.D899: A fluid-dynamics study explains and models the canoe-propulsion technique of gunwale bobbing using wave theory, validated against real accelerometer data.
cells.E899: Superposed linear wave theory (Havelock + Helmholtz) modeling thrust/drag balance in an oscillating floating system.
cells.F899: Not relevant to GSE's product; a physics study only nominally touching competitive sports in its conclusion.
cells.G899: No honest application to GSE beyond general appreciation of rigorous physical modeling discipline.

cells.C900: Application of the Pythagorean Expected Wins Percentage and Cross-Validation Methods in Estimating Team Quality
cells.D900: Compares the classical Pythagorean win-percentage model against contest-theoretic (serial/difference-form) alternatives using MLB data, finding the serial contest-success-function model dramatically reduces RMSE.
cells.E900: Cross-validated comparison of Tullock-contest-theoretic functional forms against the traditional Pythagorean baseline for win estimation.
cells.F900: Directly relevant — Pythagorean win% is a classic sports forecasting baseline GSE's model needs to beat; this shows a concrete functional-form alternative that measurably improves win-estimation accuracy.
cells.G900: Test the serial contest-success-function form as a drop-in replacement or ensemble input for GSE's baseline win-probability calculations, potentially closing part of the MAE gap versus the naive baseline.

cells.C901: An Analysis of an Alternative Pythagorean Expected Win Percentage Model: Applications Using Major League Baseball Team Quality Simulations
cells.D901: Uses 1,000 simulated MLB seasons to show a difference-form contest-success-function model outperforms the traditional Pythagorean model in explanatory power and AIC-based information loss.
cells.E901: Large-scale season simulation combined with AIC-based model comparison between Pythagorean and difference-form CSF specifications.
cells.F901: Directly relevant — reinforces (via simulation rather than historical data) that alternative functional forms beat the classic Pythagorean win-estimation baseline GSE's engine should be benchmarked against.
cells.G901: Adopt the simulation-based, AIC-driven model-comparison methodology as GSE's standard protocol for validating candidate win-probability functional forms before promoting them past the calibration gate.

cells.C902: Hierarchical Multi-Building And Multi-Floor Indoor Localization Based On Recurrent Neural Networks
cells.D902: Proposes an RNN that estimates indoor location hierarchically (building→floor→position) from Wi-Fi fingerprints, beating prior deep-learning localization schemes.
cells.E902: A recurrent neural network sequentially predicts coarse-to-fine location labels from Wi-Fi signal-strength fingerprints.
cells.F902: Not sports-prediction related; GSE's 'smart stadium' or venue features are not on its roadmap, so this is a stretch fit.
cells.G902: Could inspire a hierarchical modeling pattern (league→team→player) for GSE's per-sport probability models rather than any literal localization use.

cells.C903: An Audio-Visual Dataset and Deep Learning Frameworks for Crowded Scene Classification
cells.D903: Builds an audio-visual dataset of crowded events (including 'Sport-Atmosphere') and shows an ensemble of audio+visual deep nets classifies scene type at 95.7% accuracy.
cells.E903: Independent audio and visual deep learning classifiers are fused (ensemble) to boost crowd-scene recognition accuracy.
cells.F903: Loosely touches GSE's automated content-generation ambitions (auto-tagging sports-atmosphere clips) but not its core calibration/forecasting blockers.
cells.G903: Use the fusion approach to auto-classify game-atmosphere clips (crowd noise/highlights) for AUGUR's social/media content pipeline.

cells.C904: Optimizing the expected maximum of two linear functions defined on a multivariate Gaussian distribution
cells.D904: Develops a cutting-plane algorithm for stochastic optimization over correlated Gaussian variables, applied directly to daily fantasy sports lineup selection with positive-return NFL entries.
cells.E904: A closed-form expectation-of-max formula plus an integer L-shaped cutting-plane method solves an NP-hard correlated-Gaussian optimization exactly.
cells.F904: Directly usable for GSE's fantasy/DFS-adjacent lineup or parlay optimization under correlated player outcomes, a real product surface.
cells.G904: Repurpose the correlated-Gaussian max-optimization for building optimal parlay/teaser combinations that account for correlated game outcomes across a slate.

cells.C905: Labeling Out-of-View Objects in Immersive Analytics to Support Situated Visual Searching
cells.D905: Studies AR labeling techniques for objects outside the field of view, evaluating five designs (including looking up sports scores) for visual search tasks.
cells.E905: Compares angle-, height-, and value-encoded off-screen labels against traditional in-view labeling in a controlled user study.
cells.F905: Tangential — relevant only if GSE ever ships an AR/mobile in-venue overlay for live scores, which is not in its current roadmap.
cells.G905: Borrow the angle-encoded 'off-screen indicator' idiom for a live-odds mobile widget that points toward which upcoming game just had a big line move.

cells.C906: Modeling Live Video Streaming: Real-Time Classification, QoE Inference, and Field Evaluation
cells.D906: Builds an LSTM-based classifier that distinguishes live from on-demand video streams and infers streaming quality-of-experience metrics from network traffic in real time.
cells.E906: An LSTM binary classifier plus regression models infer stream type and QoE (resolution, stalls) purely from packet-level traffic features.
cells.F906: Adjacent to GSE's data pipeline reliability concerns (real-time signal classification from noisy streams), but aimed at video/ISP infra, not odds/stats feeds.
cells.G906: Adapt the real-time traffic-classification approach to auto-detect degraded or stale odds-feed connections in the ingestion pipeline before they corrupt picks.

cells.C907: I-WKNN: Fast-Speed and High-Accuracy WIFI Positioning for Intelligent Stadiums
cells.D907: Proposes an improved weighted k-NN Wi-Fi fingerprinting algorithm with AP selection and Gaussian filtering for fast, accurate indoor positioning in stadiums.
cells.E907: An adaptive AP-selection scheme plus asymmetric Gaussian smoothing improves WKNN indoor positioning speed and accuracy.
cells.F907: Not connected to GSE's prediction/calibration stack; only nominally 'stadium' related through venue infrastructure, which GSE doesn't build.
cells.G907: No strong product use; at best a distant analogy for weighting nearby 'signal sources' (data providers) by reliability, similar to AP-selection weighting.

cells.D908: Introduces K-SportsSum, a cleaned commentary-to-news dataset with an accompanying knowledge base of teams/players, and a knowledge-enhanced summarizer that outperforms prior sports-news generators.
cells.E908: A knowledge-augmented sequence-to-sequence summarizer conditions on structured team/player facts to close the knowledge gap in generated sports news.
cells.F908: Directly useful for GSE's automated content generation (game recaps, pick rationales) while staying compliant with the 'not AI-powered' branding since it's a backend NLG technique.
cells.G908: Feed GSE's own structured pick/grading data as the 'knowledge corpus' to auto-generate recap copy explaining why a pick hit or missed, in on-brand deterministic language.

cells.C909: Ice hockey player identification via transformers and weakly supervised learning
cells.D909: Uses a transformer network on player tracklets plus weakly-supervised frame labels and play-by-play shift data to identify NHL players by jersey number with improved accuracy.
cells.E909: A transformer classifies jersey numbers from temporal sequences of player crops, refined using weak labels and OCR-derived shift data.
cells.F909: Tangential to GSE's core stack (no computer-vision video ingestion), but relevant if player-tracking data ever augments its NFL/MLB/MLS pipelines.
cells.G909: If GSE ever scrapes broadcast video, this jersey-ID method could auto-verify player identity in scraped highlight clips for its content-automation feature.

cells.C910: Bayesian inference of the climbing grade scale
cells.D910: Applies MCMC to a dynamic Bradley-Terry whole-history rating model to estimate the logarithmic difficulty scale of rock-climbing grades from historical ascent data.
cells.E910: A time-varying Bradley-Terry (paired-comparison) model is fit via MCMC to recover a log-scale 'difficulty' parameter analogous to decibels.
cells.F910: Strong methodological parallel to GSE's need for per-sport probability models — Bradley-Terry/Whole-History-Rating is a proven Bayesian alternative to naive Elo-style calibration.
cells.G910: Adapt whole-history-rating MCMC as a candidate per-sport skill model feeding the ensemble, potentially closing the calibration gap alongside the CEPT e-process layer.

cells.C911: Employment in Tourism Industries: Are there Subsectors with a Potentially Higher Level of Income?
cells.D911: Panel-data study of OECD tourism-sector employment shows travel agency and sports/recreation labor forces are associated with higher tourism receipts per arrival.
cells.E911: Panel regression models relate subsector employment composition to tourism revenue per arrival across 24 countries.
cells.F911: Not relevant to GSE's technical stack; it's a labor economics study only incidentally mentioning the sports/recreation industry.
cells.G911: No meaningful product angle beyond noting sports-adjacent tourism economics could inform future B2B market-sizing narratives, at best a stretch.

cells.C912: Classifying Human Activities with Inertial Sensors: A Machine Learning Approach
cells.D912: Surveys and compares ML/deep-learning approaches for human activity recognition from smartphone inertial sensor data.
cells.E912: Benchmarks classical ML and DNN classifiers on accelerometer/gyroscope time-series to recognize activity types.
cells.F912: Not applicable to GSE, which consumes structured stats/odds data rather than wearable sensor streams.
cells.G912: Only a stretch: if GSE's Galaxy Dynasty game ever integrates fitness-tracker mini-games, this HAR survey could inform activity-based scoring features.

cells.C913: Modelling and Optimisation of Resource Usage in an IoT Enabled Smart Campus
cells.D913: A thesis using IoT sensor data and AI to model and optimize utilization of campus facilities, including sports centers, at UNSW Sydney.
cells.E913: IoT-based sensing combined with predictive analytics forecasts and optimizes facility/resource usage patterns.
cells.F913: Not relevant to GSE's product; it's about physical facility management rather than sports outcome prediction.
cells.G913: No direct fit; at most a conceptual analogy for 'utilization forecasting' methodology transferable to bettor-engagement/usage forecasting on the GSE platform.

cells.C914: Statistical Properties of Rankings in Sports and Games
cells.D914: Analyzes rank distributions and dynamics (diversity, entropy, complexity, 'system closure') across twelve sports/games datasets, showing a simple random-walk model reproduces observed ranking behavior.
cells.E914: Defines rank-dynamics metrics and fits a random-walk generative model to explain how sports rankings evolve and turn over.
cells.F914: Directly relevant to GSE's ranking/rating systems — offers diagnostic metrics (rank entropy, volatility) to sanity-check per-sport rating stability feeding the calibration gate.
cells.G914: Use 'rank entropy'/'system closure' metrics as automated drift-detection signals that flag when a sport's rating system needs recalibration before Brier/ECE windows are evaluated.

cells.C915: Deep Artificial Intelligence for Fantasy Football Language Understanding
cells.D915: Describes ESPN's production ML pipeline combining NLP over news/podcasts with deep classifiers and a regression ensemble to project fantasy football player points (RMSE 6.78).
cells.E915: Entity-detection NLP feeds player-outcome classifiers (bust/boom/injury) whose outputs are combined via multiple regression ensembling with projection data.
cells.F915: A close production analog to GSE's own prediction-engine/ensemble problem — same architecture pattern (NLP signal extraction + ensemble regression) for player-level projections.
cells.G915: Mine scraped news/injury-report text with similar entity detectors as a bootstrap-mode confidence input, downgrading confidence when news-derived uncertainty signals are high.

cells.C916: Render In-between: Motion Guided Video Synthesis for Action Interpolation
cells.D916: Proposes a motion-guided neural video interpolation framework that upsamples human-activity footage using a learned skeletal motion model plus neural rendering.
cells.E916: A motion-capture-trained model predicts high-frame-rate poses between frames, which a neural renderer converts into full video frames.
cells.F916: Only tangential — relevant if GSE's content-automation arm ever needs synthetic highlight/replay generation for social media.
cells.G916: Could generate smoothed 'what almost happened' replay animations for near-miss picks as engaging social content, without claiming any AI branding publicly.

cells.C917: Distantly Supervised Semantic Text Detection and Recognition for Broadcast Sports Videos Understanding
cells.D917: Introduces a distant-supervision technique to automatically build sports-clock OCR datasets, enabling highly accurate scoreboard text detection/recognition for broadcast videos at scale.
cells.E917: Automatic weak labeling generates training data for text detectors/recognizers specialized to sports-clock overlays, refined with data augmentation.
cells.F917: Relevant to GSE's data-ingestion goals only if it ever scrapes broadcast video for live scores/clock state, complementing its existing scraping/odds pipelines.
cells.G917: Apply the distant-supervision recipe to auto-label scraped screenshots from free sports sites, cheaply expanding training data for GSE's own scraping-robustness models.

cells.C918: What does not get observed can be used to make age curves stronger: estimating player age curves using regression and imputation
cells.D918: Shows selection bias distorts NHL player age-performance curves and proposes imputation-based estimation methods that yield lower RMSE and more accurate curve shapes.
cells.E918: Missing-data imputation methods combined with regression correct for selection bias in who gets observed at each age, improving age-curve estimates.
cells.F918: Directly relevant to GSE's calibration problem — selection bias (who gets picks published, which players get graded) is exactly the kind of hidden bias degrading Brier/ECE.
cells.G918: Apply the same imputation logic to GSE's settled-picks dataset: model which games/players get modeled at all, to detect and correct selection bias skewing the calibration gate.

cells.C919: Extraction of Positional Player Data from Broadcast Soccer Videos
cells.D919: Presents a full pipeline (field registration, player detection, team assignment) for automatically extracting player positional data from broadcast soccer video, with new evaluation metrics.
cells.E919: Chained computer-vision modules jointly register the pitch, detect players, and assign teams to reconstruct approximate tracking data from TV footage.
